news.title: 猩红沙漠 DLC 延迟两周，请和我一起祝愿开发者“慢慢来，请喝点水”
news.summary: Even a man forged from steel falters sometimes.

content.v: Crimson Desert dev Pearl Abyss has announced that its Charting the Unknown DLC will now release on October 29 , two weeks on the dot after its original planned launch of October 15. After seven months of a blistering pace of updates for the singleplayer RPG, I feel like I speak for all (most?) of us when I say: Take a breather, champ. It's ok. Please don't rush. We understand. Its new release times are:
Europe
North America
Asia

News writer Harvey Randall expressed a similar sentiment in August when Pearl Abyss announced it was slowing down the pace of free updates to Crimson Desert in order to focus on DLC development. Since launch, Crimson Desert has added new critters, new chests, a shotgun, new difficulty options, new mounts, boss rematches⁠—too much, really. I haven't played, but my friend keeps telling me about a "kung-fu button" that's supposedly in the game. Is he pulling my leg? Why would I not believe him at this point?

Charting the Unknown's first trailer contained a lot , but features producer Mollie Taylor fixated on the building construction options , something that reminds me of Skyrim's Hearthfire DLC. Mollie said it also showcased "running on water" and "grabbing onto a shark like some sort of aquatic Uber." What do you do in this game, again?

While the delay indicates this DLC is coming in hot, it hardly even feels like anything amid an industry dominated by increasingly lengthy development times. It's like Pearl Abyss is still blowing out the rest of the field in a 1600m race, but is now out of contention to break a world record. It's fine, man. You did enough.

content.v: 近日华为轮值董事长徐直军表示，昇腾(Ascend)芯片在中国市场份额已超越英伟达。
华为主攻以Peerium计算架构与UnifiedBus高速总线技术为核心的SuperPoD解决方案，可支持百万级处理器协作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791068480_107741.jpg
据机构统计与华为全连接大会最新公布数据，华为昇腾系列AI芯片在中国市场份额已达50%，一举超越英伟达的8%。
相较于2022年英伟达独占中国95%市场份额、昇腾仅占3%的局面，市场格局在四年间实现大幅逆转。
徐直军坦言，若单看单一芯片，华为面临的瓶颈在于可用先进制程节点受限;然而，通过将大量芯片互连组成大型计算机，华为已取得全球领先地位。
华为全新Peerium计算架构与UnifiedBus(灵衢总线)技术，可支持多达一百万个处理器实现对等互连，打破传统主从设计范式，大幅提升大模型训练的模型浮点运算利用率(MFU)。
针对软件生态与芯片集群规模，海思首席科学家廖恒博士指出，两年前昇腾最大障碍在于PyTorch与CUDA形成的软件壁垒。
但随着近18个月来模型数学与程序设计复杂度提升，新编译器语言不断涌现，前沿实验室已不再过度依赖CUDA，软件差距正大幅缩小甚至趋于平衡。
此外，针对华为正部署测试的25.6万张计算卡Atlas 950 SuperPoD超级节点，廖恒透露，此规模是为了支持未来两年中国6至7家前沿AI实验室训练10万亿至40万亿参数规模的基础大模型，同时也是考量数据中心电网与电力输送承载力的理性选择。

content.v: 《最终幻想7》重制三部曲战斗总监远藤辉树表示，团队在三部作品中多次调整回合制指令与实时操作的比例。到了第三部《最终幻想7：启示》临近推出时，他仍无法给出唯一理想的平衡答案。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791066393_461708_jpg_r.jpg
远藤辉树认为，战斗系统过于复杂会带来问题；但如果续作只做小幅修改、缺少新要素，也可能无法满足玩家对新鲜感的期待。因此，他倾向于在每部作品中重新思考各项机制的用途，再为新游戏重新组合。
他还谈到了FITS系统。该系统带有类似职业系统的特征，玩家可以调整队伍成员的能力和战斗风格。远藤辉树表示，魔晶石仍是系列角色自定义的基础；FITS旨在让玩家在魔晶石构筑之上进一步明确角色定位，而不是削弱原有的培养自由度。
此前，《最终幻想7：重制版》和《最终幻想7：重生》均设有经典模式，角色可自动战斗，玩家则集中下达指令。远藤辉树说，持续尝试不同设计，正是他没有厌倦三部作品开发工作的原因。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 近日外媒GameInformer披露《GTA6》新细节，包括杰森与露西亚关系系统，全新的警方通缉机制、飓风天气以及野生动物生态等。R星艺术总监Aaron Garbut坦言，大众对该作的期待可谓史无前例，而他们也对此高度重视，绝不掉以轻心。这无疑是一项极具挑战性的艰巨任务。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791067249_451111_jpg_r.jpg
《GTA6》双主角拥有独立的关系数值系统，和通缉、犯罪热度系统相互独立。玩家可以自由选择把杰森和露西亚培养成恋人，也可以只维持犯罪搭档、好朋友的关系，感情线完全可选，不是强制恋爱剧情。
无论玩家怎么操作，都不能让两人分手、彻底拆分开这对组合。哪怕你几乎只操控其中一人、忽视二人互动，二者依旧会作为犯罪搭档贯穿主线，不会出现决裂离队的剧情，也无法把其中一名主角踢出故事。
一起做任务、抢劫、逛街、出游会提升二人羁绊。长期忽略互动，关系会变淡，互动对话随之改变。羁绊高低只会改变剧情对话、人物相处氛围，不会提供任何战斗、道具、属性类的游戏实质奖励，只有叙事层面的差异。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791067249_924712_jpg_r.jpg
关系深浅会影响部分过场与剧情表现，但不会改变主线大走向，无论羁绊高低都可以通关完整故事。不想体验感情内容的玩家，可以完全不去经营这套系统，不会受到惩罚，依旧能体验全部主线内容。
官方表示《GTA6》故事的底色是一对亡命搭档的冒险。剧情框架决定大部分流程里他们必须并肩行动，玩家可以选择投入或者回避情感部分，但无法拆散这对搭档。

news.title: Valorant玩家声称通过二手CPU继承了硬件禁令，Riot反作弊老板对故事的部分内容提出异议
news.summary: Unlikely, but not impossible?

content.v: After-Cartoonist-196's original post was reported on by PC World , and has independently made the rounds on social media as well. They say they bought the CPU on September 21, and that the original owner's ban was logged on August 12.

On Twitter, Koskinas said he was unable to find a support ticket matching After-Cartoonist-196's details, and that the story is "pretty unlikely." Koskinas pointed out that Riot hardware bans have a four month maximum duration, and that Riot support is required to provide the remaining duration of the ban when responding to a ticket.

That does leave much of the original story intact still: If the ban began on August 12, it will not hit the duration limit until mid-December. Koskinas firmly debunked one aspect of the story, though: He denied, in two separate posts , that a system's other hardware is blacklisted when detected alongside a banned component.

We reached out to After-Cartoonist-196 after the PC World article was published, but before Koskinas' public response. The core of the story⁠—that this player inherited another's hardware ban⁠—still seems plausible, and while not as drastic as initially presented by After-Cartoonist-196, it would certainly be an aggravating, Kafkaesque ordeal to get locked out of your favorite game in such a way, no matter the duration.

Assuming the original Reddit account is fully truthful, my theory would be that a shoddy support response resulted in the system ban miscommunication—whatever the official policy cited by Koskinas, Riot is a large company with many divisions and external contractors.

The story speaks to the invasiveness of the most advanced anticheat measures in effect today. I'm not a fan of kernel-level anticheat, myself, but competitive game developers swear by it . Your mileage may vary: I just don't really play this kind of esports-centric competitive game anymore for this, and a host of other reasons.

本项目由创意总监Jean Tyulegenov和创意制作人Dmitri Ogorodnikov参与打造。担任美术总监的Space Meerkat是一位克罗地亚3D艺术家，也有电影创作背景。他表示灯光、焦点和构图可以帮助塑造游戏空间，而不只是装饰画面。
Space Meerkat的设计方案将赛博朋克与粗野主义建筑结合，并吸收亚洲和东欧的文化元素。相比该题材常见的明亮霓虹，他希望呈现更冷峻的工业未来：裸露混凝土与庞大的建筑尺度成为主要视觉特征，未来技术则退居次要位置。

content.v: 前《上古卷轴5：天际》首席设计师Bruce Nesmith在采访中回忆，开发团队曾研究玩家离开游戏初始地牢后的去向。按他的说法，约30%的玩家没有沿预期路线前往河木镇，而是走向野外，开始自行探索。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791065712_904700_jpg_r.jpg
玩家逃离海尔根后，便能看见山川、村落和废墟等地点，也可以很早就偏离主线。Nesmith认为，约三成玩家选择另走一条路，印证了团队希望让玩家感到自由的设计目标。
Nesmith表示，要实现这种自由，开发者不能只让道路保持开放。玩家可能在不同时间、以不同顺序触发任务或进入场景，团队还得让任务和环境在这些情况下正常运作。他称团队为此投入了大量精力，尽可能让这种开放感贯穿游戏。

content.v: 《战争机器：事变日》已向预购高级版的玩家开放。有玩家通过Mod为游戏启用NVIDIA DLSS 5，其认为画面明显改善，但测试中帧率低于未启用时。游戏本身并未原生支持DLSS 5。

该玩家先停用游戏的Easy Anti-Cheat，再借助Ultra+ Mod和指定启动文件进入游戏，并通过RHI启用DLSS 5。他展示了启用DLSS 5前后的对比截图，认为角色和环境画面都有改善。本作画面原本就出色，启用后则更接近自己预期中的下一代游戏画面。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791065892_183117_jpg_r.jpg

测试设备包括AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D、32GB DDR5内存，以及NVIDIA RTX 5080和RTX 5090显卡，使用Windows 10 64位系统与Game Ready 617.14驱动。按文中测试结果，启用DLSS 5且不开启多帧生成时，帧率为50FPS；在4K分辨率、Ludicrous画质、DLSS性能模式及四倍多帧生成设置下，启用DLSS 5的帧率为170至190FPS，未启用时为200至220FPS。
测试者建议RTX 5090用户尝试这一Mod；RTX 5080用户则可考虑在1440p分辨率下使用，或降低部分画质设置以尝试4K。

news.title: 索尼工程师称PS5的QSSR技术基本可替换PSSR 旧作适配或需数天
news.summary: 索尼公布了面向基础款PS5的AI画面升频技术QSSR。索尼互动娱乐图形研发首席工程师Daniel Craig表示，对于已支持PS5 Pro升频技术PSSR的游戏，QSSR在技术上基本可以直接替换，但实际适配仍可能花费数天

content.v: 索尼公布了面向基础款PS5的AI画面升频技术QSSR。索尼互动娱乐图形研发首席工程师Daniel Craig表示，对于已支持PS5 Pro升频技术PSSR的游戏，QSSR在技术上基本可以直接替换，但实际适配仍可能花费数天。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791064694_728428_jpg_r.jpg
Craig在接受Digital Foundry采访时解释，开发团队仍需调整游戏设置，例如修改资源载入方式，让较高质量的纹理层级留在内存中。他认为，给既有游戏追加支持相对容易、风险较低；他也更期待开发团队从项目初期就同时考虑QSSR和PSSR。现有游戏具备适配可能，并不意味着都会获得更新。
QSSR已在《羊蹄山之魂》和《漫威金刚狼》中使用。Digital Foundry发现《漫威金刚狼》以4K为目标时，QSSR相比PS5 Pro上的PSSR有较高的性能开销，繁重过场中的帧率差距约为8至10帧。以1440p为目标时，两者的时间差约为1.5至1.8毫秒。在60Hz性能模式下，动态分辨率调整会缩小帧率差距。
《羊蹄山之魂》的无帧率上限 VR R性能模式经过调校后，QSSR表现与原有FSR 3实现几乎相同。Digital Foundry强调，这一观察来自单款游戏，仍需确认输入、输出分辨率等测试条件。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 微软一份已公开的专利文件探讨了在游戏间歇展示定向广告的方式。文件描述的机制是：玩家先获得一段无广告游玩时间；额度用完后，在合适的中断点观看广告，再获得下一段连续游玩时间。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791063971_429678_jpg_r.jpg
这份专利的主题是对交互式软件访问进行情境管理，涉及PC、Xbox及云游戏。方案提出利用游戏引擎提供的状态数据，寻找互动暂时中断的时点。任务结束、加载画面、叙事段落和首领战后，都是文件讨论的可能位置。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791063972_862013.jpg
到了选定的中断点，系统可展示视频或横幅广告。《光与影：33号远征队》和《艾尔登法环》Boss战被用作假设场景，用来说明广告若出现在胜利后，可能怎样影响当时的体验。这并不表示两款游戏会采用该技术。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791063973_109004.jpg
目前，公开的专利只能说明微软探索过这一技术方案，不能证明它已有实际部署计划。现有信息也未确认该机制会进入Xbox Game Pass或任何第三方游戏。

news.title: RuneScape 4 在 RuneFest 上宣布，完整的 MMO 续集作为生存游戏 Dragonwilds 的扩展开始
news.summary: An unstoppable juggernaut.

content.v: As reported by MMORPG.com , developer Jagex has announced a new MMO follow-up to RuneScape with the working title "RuneScape 4." The announcement came as part of Jagex's yearly RuneFest convention being held this weekend.

The announcement was accompanied by a brief teaser trailer showcasing the game's art style, which builds on the recently-released Dragonwilds survival game: It's like a hybrid of the latest Jagex MMO, Runescape 3, and the ascendant Old School RuneScape based on the series' 2000s heyday.

In the trailer, we see a real Dragon Quest-looking medieval town in a verdant valley under floating islands. An adventurer riding a dragon comes under attack by a three-headed dragon while a wizard watches from below. The trailer ends with the wizard welcoming a new adventurer to the city.

MMORPG.com has more details: RuneScape 4 apparently emerged out of a planned expansion for Dragonwilds. A Jagex developer said that playtesters kept asking for a more traditional, MMO take on the survival game's setting and aesthetic. Other than that, we know RuneScape 4 is being built on Unreal Engine (unclear if we're talking version 5 or the upcoming 6), and that the MMO's original, Dragonwilds expansion version was targeting release in 2027. Scaling up to being a full, new game has almost assuredly pushed that back.
If you're wondering where the "4" comes from, here's how Jagex maps RuneScape's numbered releases:

While Old School simply will continue⁠—the retro version of the MMO is by far Jagex's most successful game⁠—I wonder if the studio will preserve RuneScape 3 in any way with the version shift, or if RuneScape 4 will seamlessly continue character progression (like 3 did for 2). Stay tuned for more coverage from this year's RuneFest from PCG features producer Mollie Taylor, who is on the ground at the event.

news.summary: 不少人都认为如今游戏行业的创新力度大不如前，这已经不是什么秘密。开发成本不断上涨，裁员、工作室关闭事件接连发生，很多开发者在做项目时更倾向于求稳保守。被称为“PlayStation之父”的久多良木健也持有相同看法，他呼吁

content.v: 不少人都认为如今游戏行业的创新力度大不如前，这已经不是什么秘密。开发成本不断上涨，裁员、工作室关闭事件接连发生，很多开发者在做项目时更倾向于求稳保守。被称为“PlayStation之父”的久多良木健也持有相同看法，他呼吁开发者跳出固有的思维框架大胆创新。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791063689_664289_jpg_r.jpg
近日久多良木健接受4Gamer采访时，对当下游戏产业给出直白评价，他说：“游戏这一媒介已经陷入停滞，迈向全新发展阶段的路上，开发者需要重拾好奇心。”
不过他对行业依旧保持乐观，认为游戏行业正处在重大转折点。开发者必须坚持实验与探索;一旦失去好奇心，开发者的创作生命就宣告终结。“当你失去好奇心，内心觉得‘大概也就只能做到这样了’，那么一切就结束了。”
久多良木健回顾了PlayStation早期，团队当初的目标就是想要改变世界。他认为当代开发者应当继承这份初心，主动引领潮流，而不是一味追随大众市场。电子游戏这一媒介依旧拥有巨大的成长潜力，它未来会走向何方十分值得期待。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 毫无疑问，《GTA6》注定会成为游戏行业现象级的成功作品。外界普遍预期它将打破一系列行业销售纪录，将其他竞品远远甩在身后。近日前PlayStation高管吉田修平表示，未来大概也只有GTA系列续作，才有可能超越它的成就。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791063422_537655_jpg_r.jpg
在近期一档播客节目中，主持人向前PlayStation高管吉田修平提问：未来是否会诞生另一款游戏，拥有比肩《GTA6》的热度与市场号召力。
吉田修平表示，鉴于GTA如今已经成长为体量无比庞大的IP，未来或许只有《GTA7》才能够达到同等热度。“十五年之后，也许等到《GTA7》问世，我们才能见到，拭目以待吧！”

吉田修平也谈及另一种可能性：未来中国游戏也有机会成长到接近《GTA6》的高度。以《黑神话：悟空》为代表的作品，已经向世界展现了中国游戏市场的实力，他认为不应当低估这一市场的潜力。
至于《GTA6》最终能取得何等辉煌成绩，仍有待正式发售之后见分晓。外界预估本作轻松可以创造数十亿美元营收，刷新整个行业的业绩新高。

news.title: 前PS高管直言：开发者很难依靠XGP实现盈利

content.v: 围绕Game Pass究竟能否为Xbox以及入驻的工作室带来充足利润的争论由来已久，有数据显示这项服务用户增长已陷入停滞。前PlayStation高管肖恩・莱登表示，开发者想要依靠Game Pass赚钱基本不可能，订阅服务这套商业模式从底层就做不到这一点。游戏工作室开发作品，目标不仅仅是收回成本，更要实现盈利。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791063286_199325_jpg_r.jpg
近日在播客节目《The Expansion Podcast》采访中，莱登直言，他不认为开发者可以通过 Game Pass 获取利润。他将这套订阅模式比作赌场：庄家永远是赢家，放在这里，庄家就是微软。
莱登表示：“开发者总是希望能够参与收益分成，跨过盈亏平衡点，让自己的游戏开始产生利润。但在订阅模式下，这件事根本做不到。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791064017_211874_jpg_r.jpg
莱登提出，开发者都希望自己的游戏能够盈利，但Game Pass模式很难实现这个目标。独立小游戏可以借订阅获得曝光，这对他们有帮助。但这套模式对于3A大作并不友好。
一款售价70美元的买断制游戏，有机会冲破盈亏线实现盈利，但这在Game Pass体系中很难达成。在莱登看来，这也是PlayStation独占作品整体表现优于Xbox独占作品的一大根源。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 近日Jagex宣布，《符文之境：重燃》计划于12月2日上线。所有重燃角色将从3级起步，并采用全新经济体系。这项内容希望让新玩家和一段时间没有游玩的老玩家，从共同起点进入已有25年历史的游戏世界。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791062817_546320_jpg_r.jpg

预告片介绍的规则还包括不设置“寻宝者”和付费进度。Jagex表示，这次调整重视进度、挑战、社区和有意义的奖励，希望改善新玩家不知从何开始、老玩家回归时难以跟上变化的问题。
《符文之境：重燃》上线后，重燃角色在前10天可免费访问会员内容。

content.v: 《战争机器：事变日》目前获得86分评价，成为一篇Xbox策略评论讨论主机独占的近期案例。外媒Comicbook编辑认为，本作初期评价让Xbox选择主机独占显得更有吸引力，但独占策略的效果仍需等游戏上市后观察。

编辑回忆称，自己当年为了玩《战争机器2》购买了Xbox360，并由此提出一个问题：独占游戏如今能否再次为Xbox主机提供清晰的购买理由。据评论所述，《战争机器：事变日》目前的评分是系列自《战争机器3》以来最高的，不过随着评价数量增加，分数仍可能变化。
《战争机器：事变日》将故事带回马库斯·菲尼克斯与多姆·圣地亚哥 对抗 兽族的早期阶段。本作将于10月6日发售，编辑认为上市后的表现才是进一步观察这一策略效果的节点。
评论还将《发条革命》视为下一项重要检验，并提到《神鬼寓言4》采取多平台发行安排。编辑并不主张Xbox所有游戏都独占：多人游戏和持续运营游戏可能受益于更大的跨平台玩家群体，而有说服力的单人独占作品则可能帮助主机建立辨识度。

content.v: 近日PlayStation社区用户RealRadec发文称自己的PSN账号遭到入侵。他表示自己多次尝试登录并修改密码，登出所有设备，还重新启用了双重验证，但账号原本关联的邮箱仍被更改。这起自述事件再次引发社区对PSN账号安全的关注。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261004/1791060939_257901_jpg_r.jpg
RealRadec在X上拥有超过3万名关注者。今年早些时候，多名PlayStation玩家卷入社交工程相关争议；播客主持人Colin Moriarty的账号遭劫持后，相关问题曾受到广泛讨论。他后来借助自身人脉重新取得账号访问权。
此前讨论的一种账号劫持方式，可能利用PSN用户名、关联邮箱，以及交易编号或购买日期等信息。部分信息可能公开可见，另一些则可能被推断出来。不过，目前没有证据表明RealRadec此次遭遇采用了同一种方法。
数字购买内容和奖杯记录的积累，也让玩家担心失去账号后会一并失去购买内容与使用记录。RealRadec此次账号异常的具体原因，以及账号是否已经恢复，仍有待确认。

《F1 25》被当作主打游戏，这是一款扎实的赛车模拟游戏，本身素质不错，F1爱好者值得一试，但放在十月这个恐怖主题月份，缺少话题爆点。

《地球防卫军：方块世界2》是体素风格的地球防卫军衍生作品。保留系列疯狂热闹的战斗特色，战役模式对抗海量外星入侵者。本作同样不是面向全部玩家，编辑推荐大家尝试，联机合作游玩欢乐效果更佳。
页面所载投票结果显示，在166张满意度投票中，63%的受访者选择最负面的选项。另一项有152人参与的投票中，72%表示没有特别期待的游戏。评论区也出现不同意见：有人觉得阵容过于小众，也有人认为订阅服务正适合尝试平时不会单独购买的作品。

news.title: 《战争机器：E-Day》开发者“自豪地成为 Xbox 的主要游戏之一”，并重新关注独占性
news.summary: The Gears of War: E-Day developers at The Coalition say they are "proud to be one of Xbox's main titles" as Mi

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/01/btfiuoeldu6mkzuez7e008xhvd1icgg-jcb-u5aiuoy-1790813782471.jpeg
The Gears of War: E-Day developers at The Coalition say they are "proud to be one of Xbox's main titles" as Microsoft refocuses on exclusivity.

Studio art director Aryan Hanbeck and creative director Matt Searcy opened up about The Coalition's place in the Xbox portfolio during an interview with gaming news content creator Destin Lergarie (via MP1st ). Searcy said he and the rest of the team were "proud" when asked how they feel about Gears of War: E-Day's status as an Xbox exclusive.

"Well, we feel great because Gears has such a long, storied… It's part of Xbox's DNA. It's woven into it," he said. "At The Coalition, we feel pretty honored to have Gears and be the ones bringing that legacy forward. We know how much it means to people. We know how much it means to us."

Gears of War: E-Day is firmly a console exclusive, but there was a lot of confusion surrounding which platforms Gears of War: E-Day would be available on as recently as four months ago. The once-Xbox-exclusive franchise made its debut on PlayStation consoles when original remaster, Gears of War: Reloaded, released in August 2025. Many took its presence on PS5 as a sign not only that the series would continue to come to Sony's console but also that the days of exclusive titles may nearly be behind us – and for a while, that seemed to be the case.

Leaked listings and rumors were officially shut down at the Xbox Games Showcase 2026 when Xbox CEO Asha Sharma proudly declared that Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago's Emergence Day prequel story would only be coming to Xbox Series X/S and PC . It was a shock decision that arrived as the Microsoft gaming entity kicked off a broader push for more exclusive games . Perhaps even more shocking at the time were the announcements that immediately followed, including the company's promise to never release Xbox exclusive titles on rival platforms .

After leaked splash art fanned rumors that Xbox hastily decided to cancel a Gears of War: E-Day PS5 port, the company said it did not make any "last-minute" decisions when it comes to its platform choice. While Searcy said it brought The Coalition joy to see their new game leading Microsoft's renewed interest in exclusive titles, making sure they made a great game was what came first.

"I think this is true of most game devs: You're just passionate about your craft," he said. "We're all gamers first and foremost. We love making games. We love making Gears. So, from our perspective, we just wanted to make the best goddamn Gears game we could. We wanted it to be a technical and art showpiece, and I think getting to see Asha on-stage say, 'To return to Xbox, we're returning to Gears,' yeah, that's a really cool moment.

He continued: "We know how much Xbox means to a lot of people. We're proud to be one of Xbox's main titles – I think it's been that way for a long time – and it's pretty cool to show up now and fill that role again."

Gears of War: E-Day launched in early access for Premium Edition players on PC and Xbox Series X/S October 1, 2026. Its full launch will follow this week, October 6. IGN's early review, which covered only the campaign mode, returned a 9/10 . The game's story director was laid off just one week before it made its way to players' hands a few days ago. Now, more developers at The Coalition is bracing for additional layoffs .

news.title: 《使命召唤：现代战争 4》视频揭示了可能永久终结 Wallhack 的重大变化
news.summary: Wallhacks have plagued Call of Duty for years, but in Modern Warfare 4, Activision has a plan to change that.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/03/call-of-duty-wallhacks-modern-warfare-4-1791050037842.png
Wallhacks have plagued Call of Duty for years, but in Modern Warfare 4 , Activision has a plan to change that.

If you're unfamiliar with the term, wallhacks are a type of cheat that allows nefarious players to see their opponents' every move through walls. Call of Duty is far from the only multiplayer-centric gaming franchise to suffer from cheaters who use the tool, but it might be the most infamous example – and in Modern Warfare 4, that's all about to change.

As detailed in a new video published on the franchise's official social media pages, publisher Activision and developer Infinity Ward revealed a new system aimed at combating wallhack cheaters. Called "server culling," the goal is to make Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 more reliable – and fair – than ever before.

Few things ruin a great match faster than wondering whether an opponent earned the win or saw you through a wall. Wallhacks give cheaters information they were never meant to have. With Modern Warfare 4, we’re introducing a new way to fight back: Server Culling. Here’s how it… pic.twitter.com/62m41zMbLa

The relatively in-depth explanation touches on how cheaters have been able to use wallhacks thus far. Usually, servers share information, such as a player's in-game location, between game clients. It means that, even when you can't see an enemy hiding behind cover, waiting to pop out for an easy kill, the game itself still recognizes that the player is there.

Server culling, which saw Infinity Ward build occlusion layers into Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's environments, essentially limits information to what the player is able to see. So, if you can't see someone behind the wall, the backend can't either – and that goes for wallhackers, too.
"For legitimate players, the match plays exactly as intended," Activision explained. "For cheat developers, this creates a major new obstacle."

Server culling will touch every multiplayer map available in Modern Warfare 4 when launch arrives, but it doesn't stop there. Call of Duty's new take on DMZ, the Combat Outpost mode, Warzone, and future updates will benefit from this attack on wallhacks, too. All of this new tech works alongside pre-existing anti-cheat methods across all platforms , too.

Activision said it expects server culling to "disturb the cheat marketplace," but it won't "sit on our hands" when it comes to improving the overall experience going forward. There are plenty of different ways for cheaters to disrupt the experience for the average player, and while cheat manufacterers will no doubt look for new ways to learn from Activision's advancements, the publisher said it will do its best to stay on top of the issue.

"Cheat software can’t reveal information it never receives," the Call of Duty team explained in a follow-up post . "When a player shouldn’t be able to know where an opponent is, the server can now withhold that opponent’s location data from their hardware. It’s a new layer in the fight for fair play, working alongside the rest of our anti-cheat systems Server Culling will cover every map available at launch for MW4."
See you at launch, we'll keep at it

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches for PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S October 23, 2026. How fans will rank it amongst other installments in the franchise remains to be seen, but with changes to 2XP tokens and a villain played by Death Stranding and Casino Royale actor Mads Mikkelsen , it's clear the developers have put in the work to get players interested.
For more, you can read up on how the series' anti-cheat boss pushed back on some cheating myths . You can also check out how much Activision estimated the cheating market generates per year .

news.title: 《巫师 3》的重制版刚刚将其同时在线人数创下历史新高
news.summary: Toss a coin—oh, it's a free upgrade.

content.v: It's hard to believe it's been over a decade since The Witcher 3 first released, and even harder to believe they found a way to make Geralt's tub transformation even shinier . The seminal open world RPG's hotly anticipated remaster has finally arrived, and it's pulling people back into the Continent all these years later (now more than ever on Steam, according to SteamDB ).

The new screaming high is a whopping 123,359, which it just reached an hour ago as I write this. It's settling down now, but still pretty impressive given that its peak in August was just over 30,000. The game might be getting on in years, but it's still one of the best in its genre.

When PC Gamer's Shaun Prescott first reviewed it in 2015 , he scored the game a mighty 92% and called it "a big, beautiful, sprawling action RPG full of rich stories, and suffused with an oppressive darkness."

It may not have been a huge stride forward for the style, instead feeling like innumerable tiny steps: a bar-setting journey through Andrzej Sapkowski's setting with all the graceful execution of an Olympic gold medalist's platform dive. "The Witcher 3 doesn’t bring much that’s bracingly new to the modern RPG. It’s a series of refinements," he wrote.

It probably helps that the remaster is free if you already own the base game, which has been a Steam sale mainstay since it released to all that universal acclaim. Even with all the new bells and whistles, it's half-off as we speak for Steam's autumn sale . If you want to dive in for the first time or start a new playthrough you'll definitely finish, check out all the mods which have gotten compatibility upgrades or read our guide on how to improve Geralt's fashion sense .

news.title: 忘记 PC Gamer 所说的话：《巫师 3》将永远是我的 2015 年 GOTY
news.summary: And now it looks better than ever.

content.v: Welcome to Play This Right Now, the site version of our weekly newsletter in which we celebrate a new game, update, or DLC that we think is well worth checking out. You can subscribe to the newsletter at the link if you want to get our thoughts about a new videogame happening direct to your inbox every Thursday.

The past is a foreign country, and they do things differently there. At least, this is how I explain PC Gamer of yore's selection of Metal Gear Solid 5 for Game of the Year 2015 . Meaning no offence to MGS5—a game I spent several hundred hours obtaining every achievement in, just to have an excuse to play more—speaking personally? Nothing's knocking The Witcher 3 off the pedestal of 2015's greatest triumph.

And now CDPR has gone over the whole thing with a fine brush, tweaking and enhancing it to second-quarter-of-the-21st-century fidelity. You might say, 'Didn't that happen several years ago?' Poor reader, that was merely a " next-gen update ." Now is the time of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered.

There is already discourse, to no one's great surprise. Are the graphical enhancements good? Are they bad? Do they wrench The Witcher 3's beating aesthetic heart from its chest and stomp it into the dirt? I'm not exaggerating; people really are talking like this. Ignore them. It looks excellent. In the course of play I've found myself stopping regularly just to survey a sunset skybox, or the way tender motes of light slip through Geralt's beard. Actually, I've not been doing that second one. Don't put in the article that I'm doing the second one.

There is a way in which certain game worlds become home. They become actual spaces, fixed in your mind like places from your past. That's The Witcher 3 to me: its battlefields; its main city; and clean, icy Skellige, which arrives towards the game's end like a therapy session after it has spent tens of hours oppressing you with the first two regions. Going back feels like, well, going back—walking streets that were yours as someone younger, looking at nondescript corners and patches of pavement and remembering the specific, personal myths and legends that played out there in now-dead ages.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/aNNpuJvJf2euZF2XasqEGA-1920-80.png

And it looks excellent, of course. Better than it did before, which means just as good as you remember it. So not only is The Witcher 3 Remastered like going home, it's like going home and finding someone has, in your absence, been in and aired the place out, run a duster around, and reupholstered the furniture. There are some lovely little additions too—minor new features and mechanics to smooth your way through the world.

You can, for instance, now see all your myriad quest objectives on the world map, and you can flip between focused quests (and objectives) right there with a squeeze of a gamepad trigger. The HUD is less cluttered, and a new loot feed tells you what stuff you've picked up or been given, which is rather nice for the myriad quests that end with someone telling you 'Here, take this,' without ever telling you what 'this' is.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/phNXMUhWEgvsz5sEa2nx7A-1920-80.png

There have been changes to the game's combat, too. Some fiddling to sand down some of the old jank. This may be very noticeable to some people, but I confess it's not to me. If, 11 years ago, you fired up The Witcher 3 and bounced off in revulsion at how its swordplay and sign-slinging felt, I don't think you're going to experience a sudden conversion here. That's no bad thing. I'd be upset if The Witcher 3 no longer felt like The Witcher 3, but I do wonder if CDPR was perhaps overegging the pudding with its stated goal of making the game feel, mechanically, like it released in 2026 .

The Witcher 3 Remastered is a lovely little present and, with a brand-new expansion called Songs of the Past currently pencilled in to arrive some time in 2027, an excellent excuse, especially now both of the other expansions are free.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/R2hLaPUjzDWsoHLAYjG3BA-1920-80.png
Obviously, I need to generate a new, 100%-complete save to take into the new DLC. And hey, I obviously need to see every inch of the game's newly remastered world.
What an autumn treat: a series of warm, placid nights await me, curled up on a sofa and making my way through Geralt's Big Adventure again. It's like 2015 never really went away.

news.title: “我尽力了”——《最终幻想 7：启示录》导演回应粉丝索要完整光盘版本
news.summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Naoki Hamaguchi said he did his best to fight for a disc release as the industry he

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/03/final-fantasy-7-revelation-disc-1791044273575.jpg
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Naoki Hamaguchi said he did his best to fight for a disc release as the industry heads toward a "future where physical media is essentially disc-less."

The lead developer in charge of next year's new remake chapter opened up about the state of gaming during an interview with Radio Times . It's a topic he's touched on before, but this time, he explained how his own appreciation for physical media led him to push for Final Fantasy 7 Revelation to get at least one disc as the industry speeds toward an all-digital future.

"Personally, obviously, I bought lots of physical editions of games as a child. Sometimes I buy digital editions of games, but if I'm particularly attached to a title, I want to get the physical version," Hamaguchi said, noting how the topic of a fully digital future has become "particularly sensitive" in recent months. "And you know, being in the industry, sometimes I want to get my friends or acquaintances who've worked on something to sign a copy of their own game."

Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is confirmed to have a disc option when it launches in 2027, but there are some caveats. When physical owners on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, for example, pop their discs in, they should know the full experience will require an additional download – and a hefty one at that . It's a decision that has some fans split, but not one Hamaguchi and the team at Square Enix took lightly .
"I do really like and appreciate physical media," he said. "I see a lot of people on social media saying, 'No disc, no purchase,' and I understand where they're coming from."

Hamaguchi acknowledged that Final Fantasy 7 Revelation does have a disc alternative for those who want it, even if it's just a "key disc" that only has "the opening." He added that he understands that "there are people out there with a lot of opinions" about the future of physical media and shared a message to those who feel most passionately about the issue.

"First of all, I've got people saying to me on social media, 'Give us a full disc version!' And so, from an overall perspective, let me first say that as the director, it's my responsibility to look after the content of the game to make sure it's fun, really exciting," he said. Then, smiling, he added, "The product line-up, the SKUs (stock keeping units), how it's going on sale; that is the responsibility of the publishing team. So, my authority there is somewhat limited."

Despite the "pressure" for disc-less editions and digital editions, Hamaguchi said he "used my position to put forth an argument for the physical version as much as possible." That resulted in negotiations, "both internally and with first parties," leading to Final Fantasy 7 Revelation's one-disc strategy. He added, "I completely understand there are those out there who may not really agree with that direction or approve of that direction," but it's what he fought for, and it's the best result he could conjure.

"I completely understand there are those out there who may not really agree with that direction or approve of that direction," he said. "But I would just say that I hope you understand that I completely see where you're coming from, and that I did my best."
He added with a laugh, "It is a very tricky subject."

Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will release with a disc when it releases for PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S April 8, 2027. Although its launch strategy hasn't pleased everyone, it's a date that will see it arrive months before PlayStation phases out physical releases for new PS5 games . Even after Rockstar signaled changing times when it announced a disc-less release for Grand Theft Auto 6 , Sony's decision sent shockwaves through the industry.

Gaming fans have expected an all-digital future to arrive at some point, but it seems to be here sooner than most expected. Elsewhere in the interview, Hamaguchi said he thinks "physical media will remain in some form going forward," but it's impossible to deny that change is coming.
"But the PC market, for example, is going from strength to strength, and lots of people already purchase digital copies of games and just download them.

"So, I can see a world in the not-too-distant future where physical media is essentially disc-less. You would have a copy of the code on a piece of paper inside the physical box or something like that."

For more on why the Square Enix team chose to approach Final Fantasy 7 Revelation's physical release the way it did, you can see Hamaguchi's explanation here . You can also read more about the director's love for physical media .

news.title: Deadlock是MOBA角色设计之王，这一切都归功于Valve对纽约风格的拥抱
news.summary: I want to be a part of it…

content.v: The Cursed Apple, wherein Valve’s latest MOBA Deadlock takes place, is ‘an urban fantasy setting’ in the same way that Limp Bizkit is ‘an American rock band.’ Sure, the label is accurate, but Deadlock is unmistakably, crucially, and specifically New York the same way Fred Durst is sort of like the living avatar of Jacksonville, Florida.

The latest batch of new heroes just unveiled as part of the City Never Sleeps embraces this aspect of the game and takes it to new heights. Almost all the new characters are the sights and sounds of New York City: old man playing chess in the park? That’s Solomon, a chessboard-wielding wizard. A grandma on a park bench, feeding pigeons? That’s Baba, a cheeky twist on Slavic folklore. What about those giant, slimy rats always gnawing on floor pizza? Enter the literal Rat King, who makes all of da rules.

Just look at this fan concept for a Chinese immigrant and construction worker reimagined as Sun Wukong (who natural law mandates must appear as a playable character in every MOBA ). Deadlock’s online community is always abuzz with ruminations about what comes next the same way you can find with games like Heroes of the Storm or Smash Bros., but their enthusiasm isn’t for games they’ve already played or stories that have already been told. It’s for the winding alleyways and wild card denizens of the real-life NYC, pulled through a prism of macabre magic.

Maybe that sounds like a gimmick, but the game is never content to leave these characters without dimension. Vyper isn’t just a slithering sewer lizard with a firearm, she’s a chronic flirt and a dismal career criminal. Seven may be a cackling pulp serial villain, but mark his tender memories of friendly wight Kelvin and his affinity for the naive, almost childlike goo monster Viscous.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/58ZH7CWxxXKpZpcjbHRnT8-1920-80.jpg

It's refreshing because a lot of MOBA heroes are basically action figures: emphatic, unsubtle, function-first designs where narrative is a secondary priority at best. It’s obvious why this is if you know the genre’s history—MOBA progenitor DotA's designs all came from Warcraft, and its successors haven't been able to fully get away from that. Sure, Dota 2’s Disruptor has a unique backstory, and he’s an oglodi rather than an orc , but no amount of reverse-engineering will erase the truth from my memory: he is Thrall, but red.

League isn't too far off from that, taking generic character concepts with rough DotA counterparts and retooling them for a standalone game—one with a narrative that wouldn’t be figured out for years. Heroes of the Storm's Smash Bros. grab bag of Blizzard favorites has its own charm, but it certainly isn't cohesive. Smite draws from a different well, but real-world mythology is even more archetypal and constrained by prior assumptions than Blizzard's fantasy cast.

That’s not to say you can’t tell a good story with ‘Thrall, but red.' Dota 2 actually has a lot of fun storytelling if you look for it. But Deadlock breaks new ground for MOBA-pilled lore fiends simply because it's not so beholden to its forebears.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/jE5RZDnhpGR6GUWE7qQ4V8-1920-80.jpg

Deadlock is the rare MOBA with both an original story to tell and the blank canvas necessary to tell it best. Valve has seized this opportunity with apparent relish, and you can see the results of that in the oodles of fan art pouring out for each of the newest six characters, only one of whom is even out at this point. Every time the community gets its hands on unique names for over 100 of the Rat King's unique rat citizens or Valve patches in " over 10,000 non-ping voice lines " in a single pre-release update, playtest enthusiasm renews all over again (it just hit a new all-time concurrent player count peak yesterday, according to SteamDB ).
CAN YOU PUT A PRICE ON PEACE?BECAUSE I SURE CAN!Deadman Danny #deadlock pic.twitter.com/KJGYBhulyh September 30, 2026

Deadlock's specific emphasis on New Yorkian archetypes also begs the question, what’s next? I need a ghostly muckraker journalist. A witch with a hot dog cart. A greedy, monstrous landlord who charges his enemies soul rent! I’m giddy for what’s to come the same way I am with a crossover fighting game, but there’s not that latent stench of knowing it all doubles as advertising for other products. For every bit it’s a pulpy fantasy world, Deadlock is a celebration of the real one outside. And where other MOBAs are sketching in familiar margins, it still feels fresh two years into its "private" playtest.

news.title: 你的生活有没有被你在 MMO 中遇到的人改变过？
news.summary: Raise a glass to your digital ride-or-dies.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PgGhmt5pTtxusaQQX3dHPF-1920-80.png

This is Terminally Online : PC Gamer's very own MMO column. Every other week, I'll be sharing my thoughts on the genre, interviewing fellow MMO-heads like me, taking a deep-dive into mechanics we've all taken for granted, and, occasionally, bringing in guest writers to talk about their MMO of choice.

WoW: Forever's had me nostalgic for a bygone era of MMOs that seems to be enjoying a touch of a resurgence—the idea of a lived-in immersive world, versus the daily task theme park of modern MMO design. Not that I have anything against the latter, mind. Theme parks are neat and roller coasters are fun.

But I have, true to the point, been grouping up with strangers more often in a slower-burn world, partially for convenience, but also partially because the slower pace has me less hungry for rampant progress and time saving. I've gotta hike for six minutes to get to this quest anyway, why wouldn't I stop and help someone in trouble?

When I get all sappy and soft-hearted like this, I also think of The Remarkable Life of Ibelin , a documentary about a WoW player Mats Steen, who sadly died in 2014 of Duchenne muscular dystrophy—a man whose closest online friends travelled from across the world to attend his funeral.

Steen had a massive impact that I wouldn't presume to match, but in my 16 years playing MMOs (and roleplaying in them, like some kind of nerd), I've also met a lot of people who have changed my life. My first girlfriend, for instance—but I've also made a lot of friends who've become part of my social makeup, as much as any of my "real" pals.

I won't name them for privacy's sake, but one of these people—though I've only heard their voice for the better half of a decade we've known each other, for reasons I cannot share—has been a constant force of good in my life, and I hers. We've pulled each other out of some real mental swamps in the time we've known each other, and I've even met her sister in the real world through sheer accident.

Hopping from City of Heroes: Homecoming to Final Fantasy 14, we've told countless stories together in both MMOs. We know plenty about each other—she knows I write for this very website—but it's all been in the tiny, cosy window of Discord. It would not be going too far to call this person one of my best friends, and while I have a more regular balance of "real world" mates and digital friendships, the latter ones have never stopped being vital.

Ultimately, the friendships are what make these games—beyond any trick of design, art asset, raid, or loot system—special. As such, I'm carving out this week's Terminally Online to ask you all about the folks you've met in MMOs who've changed your life for the better: Please share in the comments below!

news.summary: These interactive short stories are too bold and surprising to stay secret.

content.v: Weird Weekend is our regular Saturday column where we celebrate PC gaming oddities: peculiar games, strange bits of trivia, forgotten history. Pop back every weekend to find out what Jeremy, Josh, Rick and Ted have become obsessed with this time, whether it's the canon height of Thief's Garrett or that time someone in the Vatican pirated Football Manager .

There is a place, deep beneath the earth, where the narrative wranglers behind our favourite games come together. Writers who helped deliver the perfect ending for Destiny in The Final Shape, or make sense of Stellaris' irresistible mix of strategy and story. Who spun up the Tim Curry sass of Baldur's Gate 3 companion Astarion, and scribbled the funny ambient dialogue that shows up in Borderlands 4 compilation videos.
They all tangle in Fallen London , the marvellous and sprawling text-based RPG from the makers of Sunless Sea. And there, they do their bravest, smartest, most depraved and moving work.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/rCZM82nyJUDruzjXnDhfua-1920-80.png

You play Fallen London in your browser, but it helps to abandon your expectations about how slight, forgettable or exploitative browser games can be. Failbetter's RPG is a near-bottomless brunch of comic and cosmic horror—an interlaced network of choice-driven, literary stories that have been woven together over a decade and a half. It is a regularly updated and living world, riddled with intriguing mysteries and set against the backdrop of a sunken Victorian capital city.

Most Fallen London players are in pursuit of some overarching main quest that swallows up their resources as a gadabout-slash-magnate. These adventures, put together in episodic installments by Failbetter, take you far across the unterzee and eventually up to the cavern roof where the false-stars shift and glitter. They take months and years to see through; Fallen London is a game you might prod at in spare moments on your phone, but gradually becomes a slow-burn and deeply rewarding parallel existence.

In between these major plotlines, however, come Exceptional Stories. Reserved for subscribers, these are bite-sized, entry-level quests that show up every month, as regular as a ratwork watch. They're not typically written in-house, but rather handed off to freelance contributors, and this fact is crucial. It's the reason that Exceptional Stories feel like unpredictable entries in an anthology series. They're self-contained, often introducing new characters whose fates are decided by the story's end. And they reflect the tastes and personalities of their writers in unique ways.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oaXtz5NCoc2XQuqzkrmYjW-1920-80.jpg

Take Baudelaire Welch, for instance: the architect of Baldur's Gate 3's Dark Urge path, which makes your protagonist responsible for a string of murders they don't remember. Their contribution to Fallen London has been The Goblin Poet—a potently sinister story in which you follow a cult of BDSM bohemians through the mirror to the Reddest Keep, where they toil to capture the beauty of the Red-Handed Queen, using their own lifeblood as paint.

The Keep itself is viscerally horrible, its very floors made up of taxidermied beasts tied together in a carpet of rodent death. But it's the attitudes of the infatuated artists that lend the story its lasting unease. Their hapless adoration of the queen is conditional; the moment she reveals the slightest imperfection, they turn on her in misogynistic rage.

"The vision I presented to you—that is who I am," argues the queen. "Who is not a different person when they turn to bed for the night? When they are in their own company? It is no different than wearing a fine suit! All of you will age and wither: why must I be confined to one skin alone?" Yet the artists reject this argument; their impossible ideals of womanhood ultimately unravel the queen, and free them from a trap of their own mak
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/x9uEXAQuXDddpSzqFA3KvW-1920-80.jpg

Then there's Tired of London, another missing person case among this year's Exceptional Stories from Paradox designer Giada Zavarise, which takes the player somewhere utterly different. Channelling the opening hours of Failbetter's most famous roguelike, Sunless Sea, it carries you north on a steamer to the Tomb-Colonies—where an ingénue seeks to escape the stifling obligations of nobility among the crumbling near-dead.

It climaxes with the kind of grand spectacle a text-driven game can offer without breaking the budget: a last cruise of the mummified living, designed to end in a split hull and a rush of water. "The captain removes the ship's wheel," Zavarise writes, "and throws it overboard." The ship lists and lurches into the black zee as the band plays.

Where Tired of London ends with a half-drowning, Nessa Cannon's tale begins with one—your own. In Old, New, Drowned & Blue, the Borderlands 4 writer offers a lethal love story, rooted in the deep-zee court of the Fathomking, who appreciates a good yarn as much as any Fallen London subscriber. Dishonored and Destiny scribbler Hazel Monforton, meanwhile, introduces a romanceable rodent with three heads in The Prince of All Rats—the kind of figure you couldn't imagine kicking about The Tower with Ikora Rey and company.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/LGKMhxJbWTvDvLeK8jnSnW-1920-80.jpg

It's cool to see AAA writers let loose in a universe that can accommodate their wildest ideas, and empowered to tell a whole tale from start to finish. In this context, their individual voices come through more clearly—rather than becoming muffled in the mix of a much larger product.

But Fallen London's Exceptional Stories are a home for more esoteric indies, too, and have introduced me to some new favourites. My ears now prick up whenever I hear about the latest story drop from Heather Flowers, a devious designer who likes to muck about with probabilities—both in Fallen London's dice rolls and in her own projects, such as the heads-or-tails mindfuck of Unfair Flips .

You might remember the name Jim Rossignol from the byline of PC Gamer's classic Half-Life 2 review—or from the credits of Sir, You Are Being Hunted, the British riff on Stalker that lampooned the country's fondness for fox hunting and class warfare. His dark whimsy has proved a strong fit for Fallen London; in recent months, he's contributed stories about a painting that refuses to live in its frame, a malevolent building that follows you around the city, and a new aesthetic movement that treats illness as art. "Oh, let me look at you, my poor darling. Yes, it's just as I thought! You have the Lily-Tongue Sweats. Fascinating. Beautiful!"
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/bwagsSPoUdsx6dedZEudmW-1920-80.jpg

September's The Poetry of God. A clearly personal work, it concerns a disabled academic who handles dangerous sigils with the same matter-of-fact fearlessness as she does her wheelchair. Yet it's also something of a Cold War thriller, full of delicious turns of phrase. Grief and yearning are briefly revealed in the eyes of a revolutionary, "like darting things in a hidden pool".

At one point, you learn that a book-burning censor has been surveilling the academic, but keeping his distance. Here Anthropy writes as if peering down her glasses at the man with disdain: "Perhaps he fears that the small woman in the chair that he has been watching might turn and look back at him." It's the story of a powerful person, underestimated.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6offQUY4CXebir2TC27dMd-1920-80.jpg

news.title: 《巫师3RE》获IGN"没分" 世界顶级RPG迎来最佳版本
news.summary: 此次评测没有公布具体评分，IGN表示，在游玩约10小时、推进至白果园及后续区域后，已经可以明显感受到这可能是《巫师3》迄今为止最…

content.v: IGN近日发布了《巫师3：狂猎重制版》评测文章。此次评测没有公布具体评分，更像是IGN对本作的评测更新。
IGN表示，在游玩约10小时、推进至白果园及后续区域后，已经可以明显感受到这可能是《巫师3》迄今为止最好的版本。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032237477012.png
IGN认为，本次重制版对战斗系统进行了较大幅度的调整。
杰洛特的攻击速度有所提升，敌人的行动也更加积极，同时优化了镜头和锁定功能，并加入了一些新的敌人行为，例如后撤、更加难以预判的反击，以及部分怪物从背后重新出现等，让战斗相比原版更加紧凑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032238047535.png
移动系统同样进行了改进。杰洛特翻越障碍物更加迅速，整体移动更加灵活；坐骑萝卜的操控也更加顺手，不容易卡在树木或建筑物附近。此外，玩家现在可以在骑马状态下直接采集草药，无需频繁下马。
技能树也进行了重新调整。IGN指出，新版技能系统减少了此前的限制，玩家能够更早解锁不同类型的技能，从而更加自由地尝试不同流派。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032238143752.png
画面方面，重制版进一步强化了光照、环境材质、阴影和反射效果，杰洛特的头发等细节也得到改善，同时加入了照片模式。不过IGN表示，游戏在主机和PC上仍偶尔会出现掉帧现象。
IGN最终表示，本次重制版并没有试图加入原版严重缺失的内容，而是针对战斗、移动和技能系统等原版较为明显的体验问题进行了改进。在IGN看来，这些调整让这款经典RPG在2026年依然能够提供更加顺畅的游玩体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032238294513.png
目前，IGN此次更新的《巫师3：狂猎重制版》评测暂未公布具体评分，此前IGN对于《巫师3：狂猎》最新评测分数为9.3分。

news.title: 国庆8千海拔的珠峰"大堵车"！排队长龙不见首尾
news.summary: 今年国庆假期，不少游客前往西藏珠峰大本营打卡，珠峰景区也迎来客流高峰。由于海拔超过5000米，加上热门打卡点和接驳车辆承载能力…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032225284305.png
今年国庆假期，不少游客前往西藏珠峰大本营打卡，珠峰景区也迎来客流高峰。由于海拔超过5000米，加上热门打卡点和接驳车辆承载能力有限，游客排队现象受到关注。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032225298705.png
事实上，珠峰大本营的游客拥堵并非首次出现。人民网此前报道，珠峰大本营旺季期间，热门打卡石碑经常出现排长队的情况；由于当地海拔高、气温低，游客长时间等待还可能出现身体不适。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032225396394.png
今年9月26日，珠峰景区在完成铲雪除冰、道路保通等工作后恢复售票。不过景区方面提醒，目前部分山路和大本营游览区域仍存在积雪、结冰，游客需要注意高原天气变化及出行安全。
随着国庆假期持续，珠峰景区目前仍处于旅游高峰期，游客出行需关注当地天气及景区实时通行情况。

news.title: NS2被曝玩实体版得联网更新 部分玩家不更新不给玩
news.summary: 近日，有Switch 2玩家反映，自己购买的实体版《咚奇刚：蕉力全开》在没有联网更新的情况下无法直接启动，系统要求先下载软件更新。

content.v: 近日，有Switch 2玩家反映，自己购买的实体版《咚奇刚：蕉力全开》在没有联网更新的情况下无法直接启动，系统要求先下载软件更新。相关消息引发玩家对于Switch 2实体游戏离线运行机制的讨论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032208075925.png
据Tweaktown报道，X游戏博主“Pirat_Nation”发布了一张Switch 2的系统截图，画面显示：“需要软件更新。现在将下载更新数据。”下方仅提供“取消”和“下载”两个选项，并没有直接启动游戏的选项。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032208481068.png
不过，随后Pirat_Nation又转述了游戏保存组织Does It Play给出的另一种可能解释。该组织认为，这种情况可能与Switch 2此前安装过该游戏的新版本有关。
如果玩家此前曾经在主机上安装或运行过某款游戏的较新版本，主机可能会记录这一版本信息。当玩家之后插入包含较旧版本程序的实体卡带时，系统可能要求先更新至此前使用过的版本，才能启动游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032208585293.png
不过，目前尚无法确认此次遇到问题的玩家此前是否安装过《咚奇刚：蕉力全开》的更新版本，因此这一解释暂时只能作为可能原因，并不能确定就是此次事件的实际原因。
更重要的是，Does It Play此前进行的实际测试表明，目前的个别案例并不能证明《咚奇刚：蕉力全开》实体版普遍存在“必须联网更新才能运行”的限制。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032209105956.png
因此目前的现有信息尚不足以证明任天堂已经针对Switch 2实体游戏推出了统一的离线运行限制。
但对于重视实体游戏保存和离线游玩的玩家而言，这一案例仍值得关注。随着Switch 2实体版游戏版本不断更新，不同卡带版本与主机此前安装记录之间可能产生的兼容性问题，也有待后续更多实际测试进一步确认。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032209202420.png

content.v: 据北京日报报道，多家外媒报道，夏威夷火山国家公园标志性的、形成于约550年前的霍莱海蚀拱门（Hōlei Sea Arch）已坍塌，坠入太平洋。美国内政部也在社交平台X上发文证实此事。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261003_zy_red_164_17/192.jpg
根据美国国家公园管理局的通报，该海蚀拱门9月23日仍矗立着，但在27日晚被发现已坍塌，确切时间尚不明确，可能发生在热带风暴来袭、公园临时关闭期间。它的最终崩塌标志着“公园偏远崎岖海岸线的最新变化”。
美国国家公园管理局表示，该海蚀拱门附近的海岸线多年来一直存在失稳迹象。最新声明还提醒游客不要进入封闭区域，并远离崖壁边缘。

news.title: Deadlock 的新英雄鼠王有超过 100 条语音台词专门向你扔老鼠
news.summary: Chat King.

content.v: Gaming's worst-kept secret Deadlock received a humongous update earlier this week, one that redecorated its entire town and added six new classes for players to sink their teeth into. On the subject of teeth, one of these classes is a tank called Rat King, a giant humanoid rodent who started out as a fan concept before becoming part of Deadlock's official roster.
Rat King loves two things in life: rats, and throwing rats at his enemies. In fact, he enjoys rat tossing so much that he has more than 100 voice lines dedicated to his calling.

According to Deadlock voice line viewer (yes, that is a site that exists) Rat King entered the fray with a grand total of 1534 individual utterances, a similar number to most other Deadlock heroes. Of those lines, 126 of them are dedicated to his power "Rat Swarm", whereby Rat King unleashes a swarm of rodents from beneath his resplendent cape—which leap onto enemies and deal spirit damage over time.

Why so many voice lines for a single power? Well, I suppose the short answer is "because Valve can". But the longer answer is that, although some of the lines are generic power callouts (such as "I got a whole lotta rats, baby!") many of them refer to individual rats by name.

Rat King clearly likes to express support for his subjects, so will yell phrases like "Get 'em Lou!" or "My boy Widget is gonna chew you up!" or "Rabies Ronnie has a gift for ya. Surprise, it's rabies!" Sometimes Rat King will refer to named groups of rats, implying there are whole factions residing beneath his cloak. Rat King's group-based callouts include "The Pantegana boys say hello!" and "Say hello to the McMullen gang!" and my personal favourite—"I brought Gumdrop's whole polycule!"

It's a great example of the huge injection of personality Deadlock received from the City Never Sleeps update (which is not to say the game was short of it before). It's worth noting that Rat King is not the only character to become much more talkative. Alongside the newly introduced heroes, Valve has doubled the number of voice lines for all existing characters in the game.

It's this kind of colour and attention to detail that has made Deadlock so popular despite players having to be invited to the game in order to experience it. How much longer Valve will keep Deadlock (theoretically) under wraps is uncertain, but let's face it, there isn't exactly a pressing financial need for Valve to push the game out of the door.

news.title: 为什么现在退房时酒店不查房了？背后其实有一笔账
news.summary: 国庆期间，外出旅行总免不了订酒店，你有没有发现近几年以来，住酒店退房变得非常简单，只要去前台交还房卡

content.v: 据万维视频报道，国庆期间，外出旅行总免不了订酒店，你有没有发现近几年以来，住酒店退房变得非常简单，只要去前台交还房卡，退房就算完成了，已经不需要像过去一样，退房时排队等待查房了。
其实，不查房对于酒店来说更划算。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261003_zy_red_164_15/1108.jpg
专人逐间查房耗时耗力，一家日均退房上百间的酒店，全年查房人力成本可达数万元，而月度物品损耗往往仅两三百元。 为防住价值几十元的毛巾、水杯，投入数万元人工，显然不划算。
免查房省去了客人排队等待时间，显著减少因赶时间引发的投诉和差评。有酒店反馈，实行免押金、免查房后，顾客好评率提升了约5%。 一条差评带来的潜在损失，远超少量物品损耗。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261003_zy_red_164_15/1279.jpg
如今入住酒店均需实名登记，并绑定支付方式或信用住授权。如果发现物品损坏或高价值物品丢失，酒店可直接联系客人追偿，无需当场对质。
住酒店免查房也建立在社会发展到一定的阶段、人们的素质普遍提高的基础之上的，是社会进步的表现。

news.title: 曝《生化10》克莱尔回归当主角 2029年有望发售
news.summary: 卡普空下一部正统续作《生化危机10》的早期细节疑似泄露

content.v: 据多家外媒及爆料人消息，卡普空下一部正统续作《生化危机10》的早期细节疑似泄露。传闻称，本作内部代号为 “Project Redlife” ，将由系列经典角色克莱尔·雷德菲尔德担任主角。克莱尔上一次作为可操控主角出现在正传中，还要追溯到2019年的《生化危机2：重制版》。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030922033435.png

爆料人Stiviwonder（此前曾获得部分准确爆料记录）声称，《生化危机10》目前处于早期筹备阶段，发售时间可能落在2029年至2030年之间，并有望成为PS6及下一代Xbox的护航作品之一。不过，这一时间表与卡普空已知的项目排期存在冲突——长期追踪卡普空消息的爆料人Dusk Golem曾表示，《代号维罗妮卡》重制版可能定于2027年，《生化危机0》重制版为2028年，《生化危机1》重制版为2029年，而《生化危机10》可能要等到2030年或更晚。
关于开发引擎，爆料信息出现了不一致。部分来源称《生化危机10》将继续使用卡普空成熟的RE引擎；但Vice及PC Central的报道指出，泄露列表中称本作将采用 “REX引擎”——一个区别于现有RE引擎的内部新工具。目前尚无法确认哪一种说法更为准确。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030922247769.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030922243499.png
截至目前，卡普空官方未对上述任何信息作出回应。克莱尔是否真的会以主角身份回归正传、《生化危机10》的实际开发进度和发售时间，均以官方后续公布为准。

news.title: 史上最惨淡！四支中国队全部回家 主场一场不胜一轮游
news.summary: 北京时间10月2日晚，随着JDG以1-2不敌T1，VCT CN赛区派出的TYL、JDG、EDG、XLG四支队伍全部被淘汰，集体止步16强。

content.v: 2026《无畏契约》上海全球冠军赛正在上海进行。北京时间10月2日晚，随着JDG以1-2不敌T1，VCT CN赛区派出的TYL、JDG、EDG、XLG四支队伍全部被淘汰，集体止步16强。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031414433069.png
本届上海全球冠军赛也是《无畏契约》全球冠军赛首次落地中国。赛事于9月24日正式开赛，共有来自美洲、CN、EMEA和太平洋赛区的16支队伍参赛，队伍取得两场胜利即可晋级，遭遇两场失利则直接淘汰。
VCT CN本届派出的四支队伍分别为一号种子TYL、二号种子JDG、三号种子EDG以及四号种子XLG。四队在首轮比赛中全部落败，随后又全部在败者组首轮出局，最终没有任何一支CN队伍进入上海冠军赛淘汰赛阶段。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031414561788.png
从最终数据来看，CN赛区此次上海冠军赛的整体成绩相当惨淡。
四支队伍在两轮比赛中合计取得0场大场胜利、2张地图胜利，16张地图失利，整体地图战绩为2-16。其中TYL和JDG各赢下一张地图，XLG与EDG则两场比赛均遭0-2淘汰。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031415066941.png
尤其是在首轮比赛中，四支CN队伍全部以0-2落败；进入败者组后，四队仍未能完成翻盘，最终在上海主场全部出局。
这也是VCT CN赛区首次出现四支队伍全部止步全球冠军赛16强的情况。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031415157706.png
对于首次在中国举办的《无畏契约》全球冠军赛而言，VCT CN最终未能留下任何一支队伍，剩余赛程将由其他三个赛区的队伍继续争夺全球冠军。

news.title: 《剑星》新版本难度太高劝退玩家 但忍一忍就过去了
news.summary: 由SHIFT UP开发的3D动作游戏《剑星》近日登陆任天堂Switch 2平台，官方已经推出试玩版，不少玩家在体验后认为游戏难度较高。

content.v: 由SHIFT UP开发的3D动作游戏《剑星》近日登陆任天堂Switch 2平台，官方已经推出试玩版，不少玩家在体验后认为游戏难度较高。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031453308116.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031453397442.png
对此，日本媒体GameSpark发文表示，如果玩家因为试玩版的难度而犹豫是否购买正式版，或许还不用过早放弃，因为《剑星》序章本身就可能是游戏前期较为困难的阶段，而正式版中还存在能够明显降低战斗难度的技能与装备。
《剑星》以女主角伊芙为主角，玩家需要面对入侵地球的敌人“原生体”。游戏此前已经登陆PS5和PC平台，并凭借画面表现以及高速动作战斗获得了不少玩家关注。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031453481553.png
目前推出的Switch 2试玩版可以体验游戏最初阶段。GameSpark指出，《剑星》确实是一款具有一定挑战性的3D动作游戏，其中“精准格挡”和“精准闪避”是战斗系统的重要组成部分，玩家能否掌握敌人的攻击节奏，会直接影响战斗难度。
不过，对于尚未熟悉这一系统的玩家而言，精准格挡也可能成为试玩版中最容易卡住的部分。GameSpark认为，如果玩家在试玩版中始终无法掌握精准格挡，因此认为正式版“太难”，或许还不必急于下结论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031453586715.png
随着游戏推进，伊芙可以获得更多技能和装备，而这些强化会明显影响战斗体验。玩家可以根据自己的习惯搭配装备和技能，从而构筑更加重视生存能力的玩法。
GameSpark认为，《剑星》并不是一款必须依靠极高操作水平才能通关的游戏。随着伊芙不断强化技能并完善装备搭配，玩家可以通过不同Build降低战斗压力。

news.title: 《艾希》新作绝不NTR恶心玩家 但会攻击Sweet Baby
news.summary: 《艾希：续》制作人老马克肖在近日的直播中，就玩家关心的剧情走向做出明确表态

content.v: 《艾希：续》制作人老马克肖在近日的直播中，就玩家关心的剧情走向做出明确表态。他承诺本作剧情“非常正能量”，与前作结局保持同一情感思路，绝不会故意用私货内容恶心玩家。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030850308841.png

针对玩家最担心的NTR问题，老马克肖直接回应：“我知道你们担心什么，比如说什么NTR。我这里真的要吐槽一下，你们想想看，游戏里面实际互动的角色就那几个。就《艾希：续》里面，男女旁白加上艾希，没了。”他进一步解释，其他角色如达哈尔和崔妮蒂有自己独立的故事线，“他们彼此之间是CP，你总不能拆吧？”至于艾希的感情归属，他的回答很明确：“艾希还能和谁组CP呢？她不就是和玩家组CP的吗？我自己都不喜欢这种NTR的东西。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030854196335.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030854507871.png
老马克肖最后补了一句：“真的有恶意的话，也就只有diss Sweet Baby了。”《艾希：续》目前已开启众筹，原定1万元的目标已筹得超过1265万元。
Sweet Baby Inc.（简称SBI）是一家总部位于加拿大蒙特利尔的叙事设计与咨询工作室，由前育碧编剧金·贝莱尔（Kim Belair）和产品经理达维德·贝达尔（David Bédard）于2018年创立，团队规模约16人。其核心业务是为游戏开发团队提供叙事咨询，以多元、平等与包容（DEI）为框架，协助审查和编辑游戏脚本、塑造角色与故事线。
SBI的客户覆盖Xbox游戏工作室、EA、育碧、圣莫尼卡工作室等几乎所有欧美大厂，围绕其参与方式与影响范围，玩家群体自2024年起掀起了大规模争议与抵制，SBI由此成为游戏行业“政治正确”讨论中最具符号意义的争议焦点。

news.title: 《街霸》春丽演员发新照 撩起裙子大秀丰腴美腿
news.summary: 饰演春丽的加拿大华裔女演员发布的全新宣传照

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031048324774.png
随着《街头霸王》真人电影上映进入倒计时，饰演春丽的加拿大华裔女演员Callina Liang（卡莉娜·梁）正在展开密集的宣传行程。她发布的全新宣传照，迅速在社交媒体上引发讨论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031048336802.png

《街头霸王》真人电影由传奇影业与卡普空联合出品，是派拉蒙影业与传奇娱乐达成三年全球发行协议后的首部作品。影片由Kitao Sakurai执导，演员阵容相当豪华：安德鲁·浩二饰演隆，诺亚·琴蒂内奥饰演肯，Callina Liang饰演春丽，David Dastmalchian出演反派M. Bison，WWE巨星Roman Reigns饰演豪鬼，Jason Momoa饰演Blanka，50 Cent饰演Balrog。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031054098252.png
故事讲述1993年，昔日并肩作战的街头战士隆与肯因神秘女子春丽的现身，被重新召回“世界格斗大赛”的擂台。影片以IMAX格式拍摄，定于2026年10月16日在北美及全球多地同步上映。

Callina Liang于2000年5月14日出生于加拿大温哥华，为了演好这位“世界上最强女人”，Liang经历了一场近乎自虐的体型改造。她在接受《Empire》杂志采访时透露，从确认选角到开拍只有三个月时间，期间她每天进行两小时的跆拳道、泰拳和武术训练，配合大量腿部力量训练，每天摄入约4000卡路里，并在增肌阶段被要求每隔两小时进食一次、每天吃下12颗鸡蛋。最终她的双腿围度增加了6.5厘米，呈现出符合春丽标志性踢击动作的肌肉线条。
她还把历代《街头霸王》游戏下载到PS5上，用手机录下春丽的所有招式，以慢动作逐帧研究“百裂脚”的动作节奏。这种敬业态度让不少原本对真人化持怀疑态度的玩家转变了看法。

news.summary: 微软已推送 Windows 11 26H2 更新

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031601367037.png
微软已推送 Windows 11 26H2 更新，虽然更新包不大，但社区反馈显示日常使用体验改善明显。最让玩家关注的是内存管理的实质性优化。
explorer.exe 终于解耦了。 过去文件管理器、任务栏、开始菜单全绑在同一个进程里，右键菜单一卡，整个桌面跟着遭殃。26H2 将部分 UI 组件解耦，提升了独立容错能力，同时优化了内存分配器，减少打开文件夹时的内存泄漏，多文件浏览时 explorer.exe 崩溃概率明显下降。文件搜索速度也有所提升。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031603291669.png
内存占用实打实地降了。 26H2 重点优化了 WinUI 3 组件和 WebView2 的内存开销。实测数据显示，从 25H2 升级后，系统空闲常驻内存普遍下降 1.5 至 2GB。一台 32GB 内存的电脑，系统占用从 9GB 以上降至 7.5GB 左右；部分 48GB 机型降幅甚至可达 6GB。对游戏玩家而言，这意味着更多物理内存可以留给游戏本身，老机器长时间挂机也不容易越用越卡。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031603308847.png

news.title: IGN 9分新作称回归独占十分自豪！对游戏品质的肯定
news.summary: 开发团队表示，《战争机器》系列与Xbox品牌拥有长期联系，能够以主机端Xbox独占作品的形式推出新作，让整个团队感到自豪。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032118275477.png
近日，《战争机器：事变日》开发团队谈到了本作重新成为Xbox主机独占游戏一事。开发团队表示，《战争机器》系列与Xbox品牌拥有长期联系，能够以主机端Xbox独占作品的形式推出新作，让整个团队感到自豪。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032118387049.png
据Tech4Gamers报道，Xbox此前曾一度尝试将部分第一方作品以多平台形式推出，而《战争机器：事变日》则成为Xbox重新强调独占策略后推出的作品之一。
在接受YouTuber Destin Legarie采访时，《战争机器：事变日》创意总监马特·瑟西和工作室艺术总监阿里安·汉贝克谈到了本作作为Xbox独占游戏发售的感受。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032118592512.png
瑟西表示，开发团队对这一决定感到非常高兴。《战争机器》系列从Xbox 360时代开始便与Xbox品牌建立了紧密联系，因此能够被赋予这一定位，对团队而言是一种荣誉。
他还提到了Xbox游戏业务CEO阿莎·夏尔马此前关于《战争机器》系列回归以及“回到Xbox”的相关表态。瑟西认为，这也体现了《战争机器》系列与Xbox之间长期以来的联系。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032119091432.png
汉贝克同样表示，整个开发团队都为能够以Xbox独占作品的身份推出《战争机器：事变日》而感到自豪。
他认为，Xbox决定让本作保持独占，也从某种程度上体现了微软对The Coalition工作室工作成果的认可。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610032119183274.png
汉贝克表示：“我们很自豪能够被选为独占作品。我认为，从某种意义上来说，这也是对我们已经完成的工作的认可。”
《战争机器：事变日》是《战争机器》系列的新作，故事时间线设定在系列初代作品之前，以E-Day（事变日）为故事背景，并聚焦马库斯·菲尼克斯等角色早期经历。

news.title: 《大镖客2》PS5终于实现60帧 越狱玩家先替R星做了
news.summary: Rockstar Games至今仍未为PS5版《荒野大镖客：救赎2》提供官方60FPS支持，但越狱社区已经通过自制补丁实现了这一功能。

content.v: Rockstar Games至今仍未为PS5版《荒野大镖客：救赎2》提供官方60FPS支持，但越狱社区已经通过自制补丁实现了这一功能。
近日，有博主分享了相关演示视频。在固件版本11.400.005的PS5上，《荒野大镖客：救赎2》运行过程中，主角无论是在草原上行走、瞄准射击还是骑马驰骋，画面左上角显示的帧率都能维持在约59FPS，同时还会显示CPU、GPU温度等硬件信息。
视频：
视频发布后迅速引发关注，不少玩家再次吐槽Rockstar迟迟没有为游戏加入官方60FPS模式，同时也有人讨论了PS5越狱可能带来的风险。
需要注意的是，这类补丁仅适用于已经完成越狱的PS5，普通官方系统无法直接使用。此外，越狱及第三方补丁可能存在存档损坏、系统不稳定等风险，玩家需自行承担相关后果。

news.title: PS5 Pro官方店标价15999元！现在买它真成大冤种了
news.summary: 王府井这家官方店的15999元是极端个例，不代表所有官方渠道都这个价，但市场价格也确实涨到了8000到1万，相比6299元的建议零售价仍…

content.v: 编辑观点： 王府井这家官方店的15999元是极端个例，不代表所有官方渠道都这个价，但市场价格也确实涨到了8000到1万，相比6299元的建议零售价仍是溢价，溢价割韭菜很恶心，但不能因此否定PS5 Pro本身的价值。买不买，取决于你有多急、多爱《GTA6》和玩其他独占游戏，以及你愿不愿意为《GTA6》的首发体验支付额外成本。
一张王府井PlayStation线下门店标价15999元的PS5 Pro实拍图，最近在各大主机社群炸开了锅。不少网友看完标价直呼 “现在买PS5 Pro纯纯大冤种”，情绪直接被这接近三倍官方指导价的数字点燃。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031509212744.png
但我们首先要厘清一件事：15999 元属于非常特殊的个例，并不能代表索尼所有官方渠道的统一售价。可个例之下掩盖不了残酷的现实 —— 国行 PS5 Pro 官方建议零售价为 6299 元，如今整个现货市场行情普遍摸到 8000‑10000 元档位，想以原价从官方电商、旗舰店抢到现货，基本属于碰运气。
涨价从来不是单一因素造成的。一方面全球存储芯片产能被 AI 业务大量抢占，内存整体供货紧张已经成为行业共识，硬件成本水涨船高。另一方面，距离《GTA6》发售越来越近，大量玩家想要提前备好主机，市场需求被瞬间放大。不止国内，海外同样出现缺货，日本甚至开启游戏时长门槛的抽签购买机制，足以看见这波需求的疯狂程度。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031509292781.png
溢价割韭菜的现象确实让人反感，花远超建议零售价的钱去买一台主机，换谁心里都会不舒服。可我们也不能把 PS5 Pro 硬件本身一棍子打成 “智商税”。PSSR 光谱超分辨率、更强的图形算力，面对未来的 3A 大作，它的硬件上限客观存在。
问题核心其实不在于机器好不好，而在于你愿不愿意为 “首发体验” 买单。如果你是《GTA6》死忠，同时高频游玩 PS 平台独占大作，对画质帧率有硬性追求，急着第一时间玩到新作，那溢价对你来说是刚需带来的代价；
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031509469302.jpg
如果你只是跟风凑热闹，手上已有普通 PS5，只是听别人说得热闹才想升级，那当下高价入场就完全没有必要，大可耐心等待供需平衡后的行情回落。
天价标价可以当作个例看待，但8千到一万的市场行情是实实在在摆在玩家面前的选择题。硬件价值归硬件价值，溢价归溢价，不要被社群情绪裹挟，认清自己的真实需求，才是避免当“冤种”的最好方式。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031509524715.png
如果你现在还没买PS5 Pro，你会入手吗？

news.title: 《天国：拯救》开发商希望涨价80美元！行业不景气
news.summary: 据PC Gamer报道，《天国：拯救》系列开发商Warhorse Studios联合创始人Martin Klíma在接受采访时表达了一个颇具争议的观点。

content.v: 据PC Gamer报道，《天国：拯救》系列开发商Warhorse Studios联合创始人Martin Klíma在接受采访时表达了一个颇具争议的观点。虽然他个人对《GTA》系列并不感兴趣，但依旧希望《GTA6》80美元的定价能够成为行业先例，带动其他3A游戏同步上调售价。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031042471127.png
Martin Klíma表示，如今游戏行业饱受裁员、工作室关闭的困扰，上调游戏售价是改善现状的手段之一，但绝大多数厂商都对此心存畏惧。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031042531294.jpg
在他眼中，R星及其母公司Take‑Two是圈内为数不多有底气、敢率先涨价的企业，涨价这件事早就该发生，也是行业生存的必要条件，他祝愿《GTA6》能够取得成功，为同行“趟出这条路”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031043016990.jpg

news.title: 国产《艾希》续作众筹突破2000万！目标仅1万
news.summary: 国产横版动作游戏《艾希》迎来发售十周年之际，制作人老马克肖正式公布续作《艾希：续》，并于10月1日在摩点开启众筹。

content.v: 国产横版动作游戏《艾希》迎来发售十周年之际，制作人老马克肖正式公布续作《艾希：续》，并于10月1日在摩点开启众筹。
项目最初设定的众筹目标仅为1万元，但上线后迅速获得玩家支持，目前众筹金额已经达2000万元，达成率接近2000倍，参与支持人数超过14万人。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031948426213.png
《艾希》是一款2D横版动作游戏，同时加入了较为明显的元叙事设计。玩家扮演半机械人少女艾希，在游戏世界中进行战斗并探索真相，而游戏中的旁白会持续对玩家的行动进行引导。
与传统横版动作游戏不同，《艾希》的旁白并不只是负责介绍剧情。在游戏过程中，玩家可以按照旁白的指示行动，也可以故意违背旁白的要求，由此触发不同的剧情内容和结局。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031949469729.png
在战斗方面，《艾希》采用快节奏的横版动作玩法，玩家可以使用近战攻击、闪避以及各种技能与敌人战斗。
游戏同时设计了多个结局以及隐藏内容，部分内容需要玩家违背正常流程中的引导才能发现，这也是作品元叙事玩法的重要组成部分。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031949569169.png
此前公开的信息显示，《艾希：续》计划于2027年5月1日发售，首先登陆PC平台，手机版预计在PC版发售约一年后推出，主机版本则仍需等待相关开发条件确定。

news.title: 《博德之门3》国区价格永降！新价格曝光 力度喜人
news.summary: 今日，拉瑞安工作室正式宣布，《博德之门3》Steam国区将进行永久调价，在本轮促销结束之后，游戏的常态售价将永久降至268元。

content.v: 由你来说： 《博德之门3》Steam国区将进行永久调价30元，这款正式发售已3年的RPG旷世神作，你玩过了吗？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031704499837.png

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031705002270.png

消息公布后，不少玩家在评论区表达了对拉瑞安工作室此次调价的支持。

还有玩家结合《博德之门3》的游戏体量进行了调侃：“什么，268就能玩到多玩5000块的游戏吗？”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031705256410.png
另一位玩家则留言称：“你们是最棒的游戏工作室。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031705166600.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031705163287.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031705172130.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031705442424.png
作为拉瑞安工作室开发的角色扮演游戏，《博德之门3》拥有庞大的游戏内容，玩家可以创建自己的角色，并通过不同职业、能力、选择以及队伍搭配推进冒险。游戏的剧情分支和角色互动也构成了作品的重要内容。

news.title: 索尼紧急修补漏洞 防止破解版PS5玩上《GTA6》
news.summary: 索尼近日推送的PS5固件14.1版本，可能直接决定了谁能玩到《GTA6》

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030907193255.png
索尼近日推送的PS5固件14.1版本，可能直接决定了谁能玩到《GTA6》。据PlaystationGameSize消息，《GTA6》PS5版将要求系统固件版本不低于14.1（即26.06-14.10.00），这意味着所有停留在可越狱固件上的主机，都将无法运行这款游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030908035961.png
14.1固件于10月1日紧急上线，距离上一个版本14.0仅隔两周，补丁体积仅1.2GB，核心目的就是封堵刚刚曝光的PS5 Relapse越狱漏洞。Relapse漏洞影响固件7.00至13.60，提供了内核级读写权限，可以让破解主机运行自制程序和游戏备份。目前越狱社区支持的固件版本最高仅到13.60，与《GTA6》要求的14.1之间存在明确断层。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610030908054927.png
对于普通玩家而言，这件事的影响很直接：如果你打算在11月19日首发当天玩到《GTA6》，就需要将主机更新到最新的14.1固件。而选择留在低版本、保留越狱能力的玩家，则相当于主动放弃了对这款2026年最重磅作品的运行权限。索尼尚未就固件要求与《GTA6》的关联作出官方说明，但时间点上的高度吻合已经足够说明问题。

news.title: 索尼PSP 3爆料汇总：性能超PS5 能玩PS456三代游戏
news.summary: 综合近期硬件爆料人 Kepler_L2 与多家外媒的信息，索尼下一代掌机的轮廓已逐渐清晰

content.v: 综合近期硬件爆料人 Kepler_L2 与多家外媒（GameGPU、Wccftech 等）的信息，索尼下一代掌机（代号 Project Canis，民间常称 PSP 3 掌机）的轮廓已逐渐清晰。以下是目前可汇总的核心爆料内容，所有信息均来自非官方渠道，索尼尚未确认。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031625342526.png

Project Canis 预计将与 PS6 主机大致同期于 2027 年末推出，但两者是否会严格同步发售，爆料中并未明确。Canis 的定位与 PS Portal 有本质区别：Portal 仅能串流 PS5 画面，而 Canis 是一款具备本地计算能力的独立掌机，可原生运行 PS4、PS5 乃至 PS6 游戏。索尼的目标是打造一款真正便于携带、轻薄不臃肿的设备，而非像多数 PC 掌机那样因散热和电池需求而变得笨重。

Canis 的核心是一颗定制 3nm AMD 处理器，关键之处在于它采用了台积电 N3P 工艺，而 PS6 家用主机和 Xbox Helix 则使用成本更低、能效稍逊的 N3C 工艺。N3P 更贵，但能效显著更高。索尼选择 N3P 的原因很直接：将芯片的热设计功耗（TDP）严格控制在移动设备可承受的范围内（爆料称不超过 30W），从而避免过度发热、快速耗电和笨重的散热模组，最终实现极薄、极轻的机身设计。Canis 的 APU 规格为：6 核 Zen 6 CPU（4 个 Zen 6c 性能核 + 2 个 Zen 6 LP 低功耗核），搭配 16 个 RDNA 5 计算单元，整机功耗限制在 15W 至 25W 之间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031625424970.png

由于功耗限制，掌机模式下 3A 大作的原生渲染分辨率仅为 540p，随后通过 PSSR 3.0 超分至屏幕原生的 1080p 输出。PSSR 3.0 首次加入了基于神经网络的帧生成，可将 30–60 FPS 的基础渲染提升至 60–120Hz 的显示效果。GPU 在掌机模式下频率为 1.2GHz，理论算力 4.91 TFLOPS；接入底座后频率升至 1.65GHz，算力达 6.75 TFLOPS，提升约 37.5%。据 GameGPU 的估算，在 PSSR 3.0 的加持下，Canis 的等效性能在掌机模式下可达 10–11 TFLOPS，底座模式下约 14 TFLOPS，接近 PS5 Pro 的 16.7 TFLOPS，并超越基础版 PS5 的 10.28 TFLOPS。整体性能相当于RTX 5050显卡。

Canis 预计搭载一块 无边框 OLED 屏幕，原生 1080p，支持 120Hz 刷新率和 VRR，峰值亮度可达 1000 尼特，面板功耗相比前代方案降低约 25%。存储方面，爆料称其配备 512GB NVMe SSD，读取速度在 5.5 至 7.5 GB/s 之间。扩展坞采用 USB4 Version 2.0 标准，支持 4K 120Hz 或 8K 60Hz 视频输出，并兼容 USB PD 3.1 快充，最高供电功率达 240W。续航方面，爆料给出的预估为：运行高负载 PS5 游戏时约 3 至 5 小时，运行独立游戏或优化后的 PS4 作品时可提升至 6 至 7 小时。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/03/small_202610031625502103.png

Wccftech 在报道中指出，价格是 Canis 成功与否的真正障碍。由于采用了成本更高的 N3P 工艺和 24GB LPDDR5X 内存，叠加当前内存和存储芯片的价格上涨压力，Canis 的最终定价可能显著高于玩家的心理预期。此前有爆料称其售价可能超过 600 美元，但索尼官方对此没有任何表态。在 PS6 主机本身的售价都因内存成本而变得不确定的背景下，Canis 的价格策略将是索尼需要谨慎权衡的难题。
