news.title: 《TOEM 2》：黑白使彩色惊艳，轻量让旅行纯粹
news.summary: 《TOEM 2》不仅满足了前作粉丝的期待，其极低的门槛和纯粹的休闲性质，也让它成为适合绝大多数玩家的电子旅行。

content.v: https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/headpic/2026/09/head-2621lo-banner1.jpg
作为一款以黑白手绘风画面和摄影解谜为核心的独立游戏， 《摄影冒险 2》 （TOEM2，下称《TOEM 2》）不仅满足了前作粉丝的期待，其极低的门槛和纯粹的休闲性质，也让它成为适合绝大多数玩家的电子旅行。如果你玩过《TOEM》，估计还记得那段追寻胜景的旅途，尽管在游戏流程中，我们的主角一直都轻盈地到处玩乐，但对玩家而言，历经重重任务与解谜挑战，爬上雪山看见极光的那一刻更像是一种朝圣。
继承前作气质的同时，《TOEM 2》为游戏体验做了减法，使其近似一次轻装上阵的故地重游。至于变化，主要体现在对美术及游玩驱动力进行了重构，而这两层重构最后以同一种语言指向了这部作品——乃至整个系列——真正有趣的关键：旅行感。
这张图片包含对《TOEM》结局的剧透 请点击后再查看
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P010605we.jpg
所谓减法，最直观的感知在于游戏体量的缩减。《TOEM 2》比初作少了一张地图，整体内容量大约缩减了四分之一，纯流程通关时间被控制在大约 4 小时左右。在实际体验中，这种缩减让人稍感不够尽兴，但并没有带来类似内容贫乏的空虚感，反而让整个流程愈发紧凑和流畅。
流畅首先归功于小地图的加入。在初作中，玩家需要耗费一定精力去记忆哪些岔路口还没有探索，而本作中的小地图彻底接管了这项工作。现在，你只需要为每张地图规划好路线，轻松转上两圈，基本就能水到渠成地集齐过关所需的印章。与此同时，入口也有了明显区分，玩家能够更清晰地分辨出哪些通往一个更具探索价值的新区域，哪些通往孤立的建筑内部。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P02160400.jpg
其次，本作大幅减少了满地图找特定物品的任务。探索过程中，玩家不再需要时刻惦记数个任务的寻物要求，到达新场景也不再需要马上打开相机查看是否有需要拍摄的地方，这同样解放了玩家的精力。
减轻负担后，玩家节约下来的精力随时可以转化为他们举起相机拍摄的动力，旅行感的营造真正具备了基础。

一旦举起相机，《TOEM》系列的交互逻辑里最不起眼但极其关键的设计就在第一时间呈现： 不操作相机时，游戏采用等距视角；一旦举起相机，便切换为第一人称视角。 系列两作一脉相承，也都有通过相机凝视、聚焦某物的互动方式——只有在镜头里，某些细节才会显现。这看起来理所当然，但确实称得上是系列的核心设计，将旅行和拍摄这两个关键词有机结合。切换机制本身就是一种表达，在设计层面也有作用，它使得拍照不只是任务，还成了探索的延伸。想要更好地观察世界，就得把相机举起来。

《TOEM 2》删除了前作的特写机制，这似乎减少了一些游玩乐趣，但更令人担心的可能是：那些重要的 NPC 因为缺少特写而变得不那么令人印象深刻。不过，本作用更传统的叙事方法弥补了这一点。玩家每次进入新地图，都会在门口遇到一位主线 NPC，这位 NPC 不仅会出现在地图各处帮助玩家推进任务线，还会给予主角一个全新的解谜工具。玩家可以用相机和物体交互来使用这些工具，它们不仅在主线中必不可少，在各类支线任务中同样大有用武之地，这种功能性绑定使得 NPC 的存在感得到弥补。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P0316640E.jpg
此外，本作的摄影挑战比前作更为有趣，要求玩家进行交互来营造出或者说想象出摄影目标。前作中的摄影挑战，本质上大多是字谜：NPC 给出一段描述，玩家根据描述去拍摄对应的事物；本作则在此基础上融合地图交互，需要玩家自己组织画面，更考验玩家的想象力。
本作的另一个质变来自跳跃机制。还记得前作最后一张地图，角色爬山需要与绳索交互并等待好几秒的迟滞感吗？本作中，主角终于学会了无缝跳跃，这不仅让跑图变得更加丝滑，也让地图的纵向结构得到了拓展。许多盖章任务中顺理成章地融入了轻度平台跳跃元素，整个探索空间的层次感丰富了许多。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P0417035r.jpg

初看《TOEM 2》的画面，老玩家可能会有一点不适应：初作那种手工风格、仿佛立体书般的贴图方块不见了，取而代之的是规整的实体建模。开发资源充裕后的技术升级是原因之一，而视觉材质的改变恰好为本作的旅行感提供了坚实支撑：初作的画面像是处在一个玩具盒内，分辨物体不够直观，玩家更依赖用相机的识别框进行扫描来观察场景。而精细建模则使得本作场景更具象、更贴近生活，玩家不再依赖扫描并分析场景来完成盖章任务，从而使得举起相机这一行为更加轻松、自由。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P051720JZ.png

从成品反推，本作美术方案的改变，未必只是技术升级。过滤掉色彩信息的黑白画面中，形状、明暗和空间层次承担了更多识别功能，而本作新增的跳跃机制与纵向地图拓展，其平台边缘、可攀爬处、建筑体块都需要更清晰的提示。精细建模让家具、建筑和杂物在黑白色调下形成更丰富的剪影与层次，也让拍照构图更为游刃有余。代价是作品在游戏市场中的辨识度下降，部分前作粉丝可能会觉得遗憾，但贯穿系列的拍照玩法和黑白配色共同构建的系列特质依然成立。

有趣的是，真正玩进去以后，玩家几乎不会因本作的画面配色产生单调感，因为游戏所营造的世界足够“丰富多彩”，特殊照片以及贴图上的质感纹理也冲淡了黑白带来的乏味。在视觉上，全程黑白并非单纯的审美偏好，而是一种情感控制策略。 它先让玩家习惯黑白，而后在结局引出 TOEM 现象，爆发出全程唯一的彩色画面，前期所有的克制便瞬间转化为极具冲击力的情感高潮。正因为全程黑白，那唯一的彩色才成了真正的“现象”——不只是好看，也能带来某种感动，创造某种能被称为 TOEM 的时刻。
这张图片包含对《TOEM 2》结局的剧透 请点击后再查看
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P061847Dt.png
某种意义上，黑白是视觉减法，减到极致，才让 TOEM 现象 成为爆发点；玩法上亦做减法，减到负担消失，才让旅游和拍照真正成立。两者共同作用，画面表现与玩法循环达成了完全的一致。这未必是创作者在立项之初的唯一意图，但从成品来看，黑白与彩色、减法与加法，在《TOEM 2》中恰好呈现为一套有迹可循的设计逻辑。
对于没有玩过《TOEM》的玩家，或许很难理解为什么这样一部轻度解谜作品能获得如此广泛的青睐。而要探讨《TOEM 2》的乐趣，终究要回到它的两大要素：旅行与拍照。前文大致梳理了本作如何更好地营造旅行感，最后一部分，我们更进一步，直接探讨为什么旅行和拍照能够有趣。
其实，对于大部分玩家来说，旅行玩法的乐趣很容易理解。虽然我们一直将其体验称为“旅行感”，但它实际上等同于冒险游戏中的探索，伴随着的往往是未知空间带来的惊喜和刺激。不过，讨论本系列时，我还是更愿意称探索体验为旅行感，毕竟二者确实大有不同，后者更轻盈，更自由，过程中没有跌宕起伏的冲击，只有纯粹的欣赏与游玩。
而拍照似乎复杂得多。在步行模拟摄影游戏中，如何让拍照变得有趣，一直是个难题。有的作品将拍照与环境叙事绑定，用拍照作为叙事线索；有的则靠设立奇观异景，把充满美学价值的物件摆放在环境中，激起玩家拍照的欲望。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P072241tD.png
这些方法确实有效，但往往挑人，且没那么适合轻量级探索解谜作品。既然如此，《TOEM》系列索性返璞归真：借探索和解谜营造的游戏空间容纳大量搞怪的 NPC 和环境彩蛋，激起玩家按快门的欲望。换言之，它不直接给玩家一个为拍照而生的景观，而是在用旅游的情境来催生玩家的拍照冲动。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P082261ZA.png
前述《TOEM 2》的所有减负改动，都是为了给这种独特的拍照冲动腾出精力。可以看出，设计者极力避免让这一作变成一个严丝合缝的箱庭，或是枯燥的收集马拉松。它剥离了那些会产生压力的系统，于是，玩家得以沉浸在“我正在旅游”的松弛状态中，自然产生拍照的冲动。而随着这种冲动得到满足，“有趣”从何而来就显而易见了。
这样一来，我们可以得出一个极具价值的结论：正是因为续作减少了功利性拍照任务，反而使得玩家的随手一拍更多出现、更加自然。游戏更少强制你把镜头对准某个特定的目标，而是将按下快门的主动权真正交还给了玩家。这就是《TOEM 2》4 小时的短暂旅途中，与 TOEM 现象 一样出彩的设计巧思。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/09/pic-P0923149j.png

news.title: 《深渊终结》补丁在发布一天后就修复了我的大部分投诉
news.summary: I spent a few days playing Section 9 Interactive's creepy metroidvania and writing my End of Abyss review , an

content.v: I spent a few days playing Section 9 Interactive's creepy metroidvania and writing my End of Abyss review , and ultimately concluded it was a fun but inconsistent experience hindered by a few particular issues. Now, just a day after it launched on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via the Epic Games Store, the studio has already cleared up most of those issues with a newly released patch .

If you missed the review, my main concern was how the in-game map would sometimes share incorrect information, like telling me a door was locked when I had unlocked it, or failing to signify when I'd found the key to a particular door. In a metroidvania, this means a whole lot. End of Abyss is a game about exploration, including lots of backtracking via roundabout paths, so when I'd plan long treks across the world based on a faulty map, it was really frustrating to find out too late that I'd essentially been lied to.

But a patch has fixed that, among other problems, and it presents an uncommon issue for me. My review only went out two days ago. The game only launched yesterday. Now much of my review is already outdated. In this era of live-service games and post-launch updates, it's common for games to change shape over time, but for End of Abyss's patch to fix many of its lesser parts essentially right after the deadline isn't normally how it goes.
Usually big, important changes happen in one of two ways:

In one common scenario, a game that critics are playing for review may be patched during that pre-release review period. It's often the case that critics are made aware of bugs we might see, and we're usually told when they've been patched out, or that those fixes are in the "day one" patch that comes with the game's public launch, leaving us to confirm as much once the patch drops.

This even applies to End of Abyss. I bumped into a few bugs during my time with the game, and the very worst of them--in which a boss failed to drop a quest item--was patched just a few hours before I had to write my review, allowing me to beat the game on time. This made the issue irrelevant to my review, and thus I didn't even specifically call it out.

If the public wasn't going to experience it, then I take it as my job to basically erase it from my memory of the experience--or at least, if I do mention it, I should explain how it's no longer a concern for players jumping in at launch.

In another common scenario, a game changes shape much later in its lifespan, and probably over the course of several updates. Games like Sea of Thieves, Overwatch, and Fallout 76 are great examples. These kinds of games often become the subject of re-reviews years later. But it's not just multiplayer games that do this. Games such as Starfield, Mass Effect 3, and Cyberpunk 2077 have been affected by such major changes that they merited follow-ups, too.

But End of Abyss is a much rarer case. The game just came out. My review could only speak to my experience, and so it does, but I'd planned to revisit it once my biggest problems with it were addressed and write something like what I've written here--something that says, "Hey, it's better now!" when I could recommend it with more confidence. I just didn't expect that would be a mere 48 hours after I published my thoughts on the game.

Section 9's debut landed in a weird gray area, where some important fixes came neither early enough for my review to consider them, nor late enough for my review to feel like it accurately reflected the experience of playing the game for a reasonable period of time. As it stands, only the players who jumped in yesterday--likely a relative few compared to the many more who will play the game over the next several years--bumped into the map issue I had during my time with it. No one else will ever have to deal with it.
That's good for players, and good for the studio, even if it leaves reviews like mine feeling more swiftly outdated than anything I can remember writing.

news.title: 前 NFL 教练迈克·汤姆林 (Mike Tomlin) 是一名 Minecraft 铁杆玩家，透露他花了 12 年建造的城市
news.summary: Former NFL coach Mike Tomlin spent 19 seasons with the Pittsburgh Steelers and won Super Bowl LXIII, and now h

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/02/mike-tomlin-1790980579414.png
Former NFL coach Mike Tomlin spent 19 seasons with the Pittsburgh Steelers and won Super Bowl LXIII, and now he's added another major accomplishment to his resume: becoming a Minecraft YouTuber.

The former coach gave football fans a little something different when he launched his new YouTube channel earlier this week. With a profile picture taken in front of NBC's Football Night in America logo, watchers probably weren't expecting Tomlin's first upload to see him confess how his love for architecture and family led him to work on a Minecraft city he spent 12 years building.

"You know, 12 or 13 years ago, when my kids were in middle school, they'd be in their room all weekend and have friends over. They were obsessed with playing this game, Minecraft, that I knew nothing about," he explained as his son and channel operator, Dino, sat in the background. "I got interested because I just was mesmerized by what could occupy their attention for such large periods of time."

He admitted he lacked the "stick control" to handle something like Minecraft's Survival mode but still managed to find enjoyment in Creative Mode. That's where Mojang's systems really started to click.

"I like to build," he said. "I've always had an interest in architecture, and so forth, so I started doing this creative city. It was a means of spending time with them. They participated all over this city. All my kids have buildings."

However, as his kids went off to high school and college, their interest in Minecraft waned. For Tomlin, it was just beginning. In 2026, after 12 years of building, the sandbox phenomenon has become therapeutic for the former NFL coach, and what he's built has the internet in disbelief.

"This is where it all started for me," Tomlin said as a blocky blue pond surrounded by detailed city buildings faded into view. His tour then begins with a closer look at a hotel. This one building features a fully fleshed-out interior with labeled rooms, a lobby, a ballroom, a pool, bathrooms, and more. Tomlin even factored in how lighting might affect the views in some of these rooms – and that's just one of many locations he's made.
"I was always inspired," he added. "I'd go places, and I'd see things and buildings, and I get inspired, I go home, and I work on it."

Tomlin then referenced the off-campus housing around universities that he recreated after dropping Dino off at college. The color, floor plans, and other memorable elements all came from these memories, with much of his creation also built around different bodies of water.

Tomlin stepped down as the Steelers' coach in January 2026, with today's video showing how he's spent at least some of the downtime since. He spent years in the NFL, but it's his work as a Minecraft YouTuber that has everyone talking today.
Mike Tomlin has been working on his Minecraft world for over a decade It’s UNREAL pic.twitter.com/XWxu9zMinY
Aaron Rodgers: “CALL THE F*CKING PLAY!” Mike McCarthy: “F*cking asshole” *Loses to the Cleveland Browns* Meanwhile, Mike Tomlin: pic.twitter.com/axnE3655rT
Steelers down 20 in a playoff game. Mike Tomlin: pic.twitter.com/J4u56digNW
Mike Tomlin leaving the presser early to go finish building the Executive Spa in his Minecraft world pic.twitter.com/yHF2FOzeiZ
"I'm obsessed why is he genuinely a better builder than me," content creator @Krtzyy said .
"Mike Tomlin becoming a Minecraft YouTuber was not on my bingo card for 2026," one X/Twitter user said .

Tomlin signed off, promising to take a closer look at his city in future videos. He also teased plans to show off something that "I think you're going to find interesting." Despite being maybe the most creative celebrity gamer to come out of 2026, the ex-NFL coach isn't the only notable name to share their love for gaming in the last year. Obsession breakout Inde Navarrette garnered attention for her The Last of Us and Call of Duty streams a few months ago . Newly announced X-Men star, Samara Weaving, is also a big gamer .
Photo by Rich von Biberstein/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images.

news.title: 迪士尼表示“现在”并未进行有关购买 Epic 游戏的讨论
news.summary: Disney has responded after rumors suggested it was interested in buying Fortnite developer Epic Games.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/04/30/1-1777571355989.jpg
Disney has responded after rumors suggested it was interested in buying Fortnite developer Epic Games.

Disney president and chief creative officer Dana Walden touched on the company's relationship with Epic during an interview with Bloomberg Live . When asked if there have been talks about expanding their previously established relationship with a full-on acquisition, she said that strategy isn't something Disney is entertaining, at least right now.

"Well, I think that it was pretty obvious that we had very serious conversations about an investment and an equity stake," Walden responded. "Those are not the conversations we're having right now, but we have a great partnership and a number of launches coming up over the next two years that are going to demonstrate the value of this partnership."

The relationship referenced here was solidified when Disney announced it acquired a $1.5 billion stake in Epic back in early 2024. It was a massive play that it promised would result in collaborations across Fortnite and more in the future.

"Our exciting new relationship with Epic Games will bring together Disney’s beloved brands and franchises with the hugely popular Fortnite in a transformational new games and entertainment universe," then-CEO Bob Iger said. "This marks Disney’s biggest entry ever into the world of games and offers significant opportunities for growth and expansion. We can’t wait for fans to experience the Disney stories and worlds they love in groundbreaking new ways."

We're still feeling the shockwaves of that deal, but some suspected it could evolve into more than a simple partnership. Tech reporter Alex Heath said in March 2026 that some Disney executives were "waiting for that moment" to go all in on an acquisition . Then, in April, Bloomberg reported that Epic was working on an extraction shooter featuring Disney characters with plans to launch in November 2026.

We're now kicking off October with no official mention of that unannounced project, but that doesn't mean Disney x Epic is going anywhere any time soon. While an acquisition isn't in the cards, Walden's promise regarding "a number of launches" set to arrive in the next few years suggests there is plenty more to talk about.

We'll have to wait and see how the two entertainment giants work together moving forward. In the meantime, you can read some of the other ways Disney and Epic have bolstered their relationship, including a Disneyland-exclusive Fortnite skin and officially licensed Star Wars minigames .

news.title: Vibe-Coded Mashup Mods 本周已占据 X 市场
news.summary: I have spent the last three days scrolling through some of the most insane mod videos I've ever seen. Modders

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/02/vibecodedmods-explainer-blogroll-1790975025611.jpg

I have spent the last three days scrolling through some of the most insane mod videos I've ever seen. Modders are taking games that have been decompiled with Claude, and mashing them up with other games. As the week has gone on, there have only been more clips of these mods pouring out on X/Twitter.

One person created a mashup of World of Warcraft and Call of Duty: World at War ; another combined Escape From Tarkov with Skyrim . There’s even one that takes Insomniac’s Spider-Man and combines it with Batman Arkham City , where the player is able to swing around Batman’s turf.

These mods are everywhere online right now, though they thankfully haven’t filtered into modding websites like Nexus Mods yet. But, with the sheer volume of these mods and with how accessible Opus 5.5 is, it feels like it’s only a matter of time before the gates are fully torn down. And if that happens, it could change the face of the modding scene entirely.
Why Now?

Claude Opus 5.5 launched last week, promising cheaper tokens and more efficient code work. I'm sure that Anthropic meant for it to be used by professionals, but gamers have used it to create some of the weirdest mods I have ever seen.

Opus is a model that can power AI agents, which can be deployed to create entire games from the engine, to the art and enemy behavior. Brendan Jowett has a great video on YouTube of the model in action: He develops little slices of video games and compares them directly with the same tasks from OpenAI’s Astra 6 model. While the results of both are far from what you’d expect from a fully featured game, Claude’s new model has clearly come a long way.

The problem with the examples in Jowett’s video is that while the models are good at piecing together disparate parts of a game, enemy AI (lol) and art assets are lackluster to say the least. In one of the slices, a space combat sim, the space fighter flys at a diagonal angle, while moving in a straight line ahead, and shooting. In another slice enemies completely ignore the player character.

As good as Claude Opus 5.5 seems to be, it’s still lightyears away from developing something like a true mashup of Minecraft and Elden Ring from scratch. But the model doesn’t have to start from scratch.

The big, driving force behind a lot of these mods is decompilation, where people are pointing Opus at a game and letting the agent break it down to its source code (here’s a handy blog if you want to really get in the weeds). Just earlier today, we covered Halo: Combat Evolved being decompiled and ported to run natively in a browser . Once that step is complete, it takes little effort to take that source code and work huge swaths of games into other games as mods, and with very little input from the user.

Couple that with the relatively affordable tokens, and it shouldn’t be surprising that X/Twitter’s generally pro-AI users went wild with it, creating hundreds of mashups. And it doesn’t seem like it’s slowing down any time soon; what started off as a weird video that my boss sent me on Tuesday has now evolved to the point where I can’t even open X/Twitter without seeing a deluge of these mods.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/02/18/likeadragonhawaii-blogroll-1739839417413.jpg
Piracy?

The obvious problem with all of this is that these models are breaking open games developed by real people, getting the source code and then just mashing stuff together without consideration or permission from the original developers. That’s nothing particularly new – the modding scene is definitely no stranger to mashups, all the Thomas the Tank Engine mods are proof of that. However, this trend might be breaking into new territory, thanks to decompilation.

This could be another reason none of these mods have made their way onto any distribution platforms. Nexus Mods doesn’t outright ban AI-generated content, but it doesn’t let people use AI tools to upload content that they don’t have the rights to.

In a blog post from 2023, Nexus laid out its rules around AI generated content. The policy states that , “In order to prevent any issues with your mods, we encourage you to avoid using these tools unless you have explicit permission to use all the assets. This is particularly true for AI-generated voice acting but also covers images, models, code and anything else that you can use this technology to create.”

Every single one of these passthrough mods are using images, models, and code that the people generating them don’t have the rights to. But it’s only a matter of time until some platform holder allows these mods to be hosted, and I’m sure a massive legal battle will happen immediately afterwards.
The Modding Community Hates This

Way before all of these Claude-authored mod videos started cropping up online, people had been creating mods by hand for years, typically out of pure love for the game. It shouldn’t be surprising, then, that a lot of mod authors aren’t fans of this phenomenon.

Mod authors have been expressing their frustration on X/Twitter as this has been happening. “I mod games and I'm not shy about the fact that I use AI to do it. I hate this bullshit ‘trend’. Pure slop, there's nothing creative about this at all,” kran27_ posted. “AI has a lot of potential in the modding scene, but the shit that's getting the clicks is this jingling keys bullshit.”

Kran wasn’t alone, with discountmodder ready to just leave the scene, saying, “Dude I'm really disappointed. If this becomes the permanent state of modding, this may be my last project. I don't wanna be involved in an AI slop-factory.”

I can’t escape the feeling that most of these mashups are born from people just playing with a new AI model and seeing what will happen, and I hope that this weird trend will die off soon. Modding is one of the best parts of PC gaming, and there is a lot of incredible content that people make just because they love a game. Some of the best games started off as mods, after all, and without them we never would have got the likes of Half-Life or League of Legends.

I hope that this is just a trend, rather than a sign of where the modding scene is heading. Fortunately, because these mods seemingly only exist to farm engagement on Twitter (at least so far), you don’t have to worry too much about them if you just want to start a new modded run of The Witcher 3 Remastered. If anything, it just means that if you want to avoid AI content, you need to pay even more attention to who you’re getting your mods from.

news.title: GTA 6 截图表明它不会羞于引用电影
news.summary: A new screenshot from Grand Theft Auto 6 has arrived, and fans immediately noticed that it appears to be refer

content.v: A new screenshot from Grand Theft Auto 6 has arrived, and fans immediately noticed that it appears to be referencing the iconic opening scene from Quentin Tarantino's 1994 crime movie Pulp Fiction.

The image was shared by Love magazine on Instagram . The GTA 6 Countdown social media account put it next to the diner scene from Pulp Fiction, and the similarities are there, especially in the framing.

In Pulp Fiction, Tim Roth and Amanda Plummer's characters, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny, go on to rob the diner, and given that Lucia and Jason are criminals as well, it's not a stretch to think that could happen in GTA 6. Maybe they're just enjoying breakfast, but that seems unlikely given the image clearly shows both gripping their pistols, with Lucia seemingly ready to fill the empty duffel bag next to her with cash and other valuables.

GTA 6 tells a Bonnie and Clyde-style story of two lovers who are also criminals. Things did not end well for them, and many are speculating as to how GTA 6's story could wrap up for both Lucia and Jason. It also wouldn't be surprising to see GTA 6 reference Pulp Fiction given how GTA games in the past have featured very overt references to movies, like how Vice City had Scarface references and GTA 5 had nods to Heat.

"We wanted both protagonists to be vulnerable, tough, flawed, right sometimes, wrong sometimes, able to learn from each other,”GTA 6 writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern told Love magazine. “That’s what we felt made them authentic, and a great team.”
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_13_0038a1.jpg?w=636

Another GTA 6 game writer, Alexa D’Agostino, told the magazine, “When you are focusing on writing a fully realized person with their own wants, you’re going to get something perfectly imperfect--with clichés, but also undeniably real.”

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. On November 18, the Miami Heat will wear GTA 6-inspired jerseys and play on a court that references Vice City, the game's setting, and a stand-in for Miami.
GTA 6 will take players outside of Miami to other places in Florida, just don't expect to go to Rockstar's version of Walt Disney World .

news.title: 《精灵宝可梦 TCG》的 2026 年最终套装已经引发了更多预购混乱
news.summary: Find out where to preorder Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Delta Reign at MSRP in the US and UK before Elite Train

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/02/delta-reign-first-look-pokemon-tcg-image-1787234126628-1790953869332.png

The upcoming Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Delta Reign expansion officially launches on November 6, 2026. It's the last announced Pokémon TCG set for 2026 , continuing Pokémon TCG’s spotlight on Mega Evolution Pokémon with the return of Mega Rayquaza, last seen in Ancient Origins in 2015.
For reference, here’s a quick overview of what’s available in the Delta Reign lineup.
A collector favourite, the ETB includes 9 booster packs, exclusive promo cards, card sleeves, energy cards, and game accessories.
The classic booster box comes with 36 booster packs. This is the best option if you want to maximise your chances of opening all the set's chase cards or do large pack openings.

Last, but by no means least, Booster Bundles include six booster packs from the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Delta Reign expansion, each with 10 cards, 1 Basic Energy, and 1 Pokémon TCG Live code card.
Initial pre-orders went live on the Pokémon Center at the end of September, and it was a bloodbath. Queues were 12 hours long, and fans reported numerous tech issues.

Oh well that Pokemon Center drop was a shit show, tons of errors and selling out that quick with reduced limits? Normally even when ETB's sell out Booster Boxes and Bundles last for a couple more hours but not this time. It just screams that this set is underprinted, maybe…
​If you want to get your hands on this set, you’ll need to be quick. Here are the best places to check out if you want to secure any of the products.
We’ll be regularly updating this page with confirmed deals, so bookmark this page, keep checking back in, and follow @IGNFinds on Twitter/X for the latest updates.
Where to Preorder Delta Reign at MSRP
Your best bet to buy Delta Reign at MSRP is the Pokémon Center UK and US. MSRP for Delta Reign is $59/£56.99 for the Elite Trainer Box (ETB).
The first wave has been, but it’s likely that there will be more soon. Keep an eye on this page for more information.

At the Pokemon Center, you can also pick up the exclusive Elite Trainer Box, which features extra promo items and metallic coins/dice not found in standard retail ETBs. For this expansion, you'll get 1 full-art foil promo card featuring Kyogre with a Pokémon Center logo.
You can also try your luck at securing the booster and display boxes - these usually stick around a bit longer than an ETB. Unfortunately, right now - these are also all sold out!

​If you don’t manage to get lucky at the standard retail offerings, you can always check out TCGplayer - a third party reseller that will offer preorders. Unfortunately, you’re likely to pay extra here due to the third party sellers looking to capitalize. In saying that, if you’re desperate to get some pulls, or lock in your booster boxes, case pre-orders, and bundle deals, this is run by hobbyists who usually put up pre-orders early. Just bear in mind it’s not 100% guaranteed if you order from here.
Where to Preorder in the US
Best Buy

Best Buy is a pretty good shout when it comes to Pokémon TCG orders. To boost your chances, look into My Best Buy Plus - a membership program that costs $29.99 per year. You can get members-only prices on certain products, an extended return window, free expedited shipping. and exclusive early access to TCG pre-orders.
Walmart
Where to Preorder in the UK
Magic Madhouse

Magic Madhouse is a really good choice for UK Trainers, especially if you’re hunting down singles. Currently, there’s no listing yet, but with the Pokémon Center pre-orders dropping, they’re only usually a few weeks behind.
Smyths Toys
If you prefer buying in-store, Smyths Toys is a great option. There is an online option too, but they usually sell out quikc. Check your local stores availability online to see what’s in stock!
Just bring some protective gear if you go to an in-person launch event, just in case. I’m joking. Kinda.
Argos
Argos is a bit of a Calyrex (dark horse, hah) when it comes to stocking Pokémon cards. They’re not the most reliable, but they do occasionally have stock.
What’s in the Delta Reign Lineup?

Unlike the 30th Celebration, which was the first-ever simultaneous global release, Delta Reign is out now in Japan, known as Storm Esmerelda. Unsurprisingly, the biggest chase card is the star of the show, the Mega Rayquaza ex Mega Ultra Rare. Illustrated by takuyoa, this card reached an all-time high on TCGPlayer of $2,166.69.
But there’s loads of gorgeous chase cards in here. If there’s a single you’re after in particular, it might be worth checking out places like TCGPlayer to save some money in the long run.
I imagine, with the popularity of Mega Rayquaza, Delta Reign might be a mad rush for stock. Fingers crossed the prices stay low!

news.summary: GTA 6 has received a rating of PEGI 18, revealing mentions of "decapitation," the ability for players to snort

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/31/hrdxhdzwwaax1k-1788198129736.jpg
UPDATE October 2, 2026, 11:39 a.m. PT: PEGI has seemingly updated its website to remove the age rating for GTA 6.

The PEGI 18 page – which, as viewed by IGN, included what appeared to be new details about GTA 6 – is no longer available. In its place is a blank listing that says, "The requested page could not be found." Users on X/Twitter have captured and shared an image of the listing and have continued to share its contents across social media. IGN has reached out to PEGI for comment.
Grand Theft Auto VI PEGI rating is now up! https://t.co/av3HXd6GQf pic.twitter.com/6MhVcAA1xc
ORIGINAL STORY: GTA 6 has received an age rating of PEGI 18, revealing mentions of "decapitation," the ability for players to snort cocaine at any time, "scenes of sexual fetishes," and much more.

The update, which can be found on the Pan European Game Information board's website , gives players a relatively in-depth description of Rockstar Games' megaton video game ahead of its launch in November. The PEGI 18 rating arrives just one day after GTA 6 received its official ESRB rating , which, also unsurprisingly, resulted in an "M for Mature."

GTA 6's rating describes a story that allows players to take control of "Jason Duval or Lucia Caminos, two criminals who become involved in a criminal conspiracy following a failed robbery." It adds that they'll work together as "they become increasingly entangled in criminal activities" in Vice City, with gameplay that, as we've already seen, is par for the course when it comes to Grand Theft Auto.

What's different about GTA 6 is the unprecedented detail Rockstar has shoved into the game , with previous footage showing off an open-world sandbox with enough activities to make up for the 13-year wait. PEGI dived into that, too, but there are still even more new highlights to go over.

The board described the game's violence as "bloody with a high degree of realism." Some weapons will be more brutal than others, with some said to be "able to cause greater damage, such as detailed decapitation and dismemberment." This time around, Rockstar has made drug use "frequent and prominent," with players able to partake in illicit substances. Cocaine is said to be especially important in Vice City, with the rating promising that Jason and Lucia will be able to use the substance directly from their inventory, as it can be "snorted directly from their hand at any time."

The GTA 6 PEGI description also touched on " strong sexual themes ," which include "nudity, scenes of intercourse, and occasional scenes of sexual fetishes." It's a lot that we knew and some details that we didn't, but you can read the "content specific issues" section of the summary in its entirety below.

"This game contains frequent depictions of violence; due to the free roam nature of the game the player can harm all other characters inhabiting the environment," PEGI said. "This includes civilians, criminals and the authorities. Violence is bloody with a high degree of realism, with certain weapons being able to cause greater damage such as detailed decapitation and dismemberment.

"Drug use is frequent and prominent with the player being able to partake in drug use with others and to use illegal drugs directly from their inventory. Most notably, cocaine can be carried around by the player and snorted directly from their hand at any time.

"There are also strong sexual themes, including nudity, scenes of intercourse and occasional scenes of sexual fetishes. In various night clubs the player can also pay for private dances, during which, the game allows the player to move their hands onto the dancers’ breasts and buttocks."

The PEGI age rating also mentioned "other issues," including that domestic animals can be harmed, though not in the same detail as humans. The word "f**k" is also featured prominently in the game, while the word "c**t" is only occasionally featured. The description also said that "discriminatory language can be heard in the TV shows and on the radio channels."

Finally, GTA 6 reminds players that they will have the option to purchase in-game items, though it's still unclear what this entails. In August, it was reported that Rockstar would not include microtransactions or generative AI in the game .

GTA 6 is still on course to launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19, 2026. You can read more about how Rockstar has ramped up its marketing tactics here , and you can see what we learned from some new screenshots here . While we wait for any more updates, you can read IGN's interview and preview .

news.title: 《火焰之纹章：财富的编织》中外战需要关注的 4 件事
news.titleEn: 4 Things to Focus on Outside Combat in Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/1-thumb-1790796752214.jpg
我们回来了“漫长的游戏”系列的新一期，我们详细介绍了您可以在游戏中早期投资的东西，这些东西将获得长期回报。今天我们重点关注《火焰纹章：财富之网》，这是这个长期系列中的大型新作，带你前往达格丹帝国的首都，成为英雄大赛中的角斗士。
与前作《三宫》一样，《财富的编织》也有多个主角的分裂叙事。然而，这一次，您不必选择一条路线。您可以按照任意顺序跟随蔡、勒达、迪特里希和西奥多拉的故事，并且在到达中心枢纽城市达格森后可以随时在他们之间切换。
与《火焰之纹章》系列的其他作品一样，《财富的编织》以基于网格的策略战斗为中心。但它也非常注重战斗之外的活动，可以访问世界地图，在故事战斗之间穿梭。你可以找到地下城、城镇、旅行商人，以及与流动敌人的小冲突。
除此之外，还可以在达格西翁这座大城市里跑步，那里到处都是商店、活动和可以结识的人。这可能会有点让人不知所措，特别是如果您是该系列的新手并且不确定从哪里开始。这就是我们在这里提供帮助的原因。以下是战斗之外的四件事，你可以（并且应该）尽快开始利用。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/2-support-1790796279494.jpg
表达你的支持
支持级别和对话长期以来一直是《火焰之纹章》系列的主要内容，每当角色并肩作战或在战斗中提供治疗或支持时，他们都会积累积分。 《财富的编织》扩展了该系统，并添加了在战斗之外建立支持的新方法，您应该尽可能利用这些方法。
建立支持的主要方式是在旅馆里一起吃饭，所有主角在游戏初期都可以享用这些食物。可以三个人一起吃饭，每个人都有自己的食物喜好。旅馆的菜单每天都会变化，当你选择三人一组时，你可以看到他们对每顿饭的感受。
每个人获得的支持点数取决于他们对这顿饭的喜爱程度，所以不要试图强迫人们吃他们不喜欢的东西。膳食对于与不积极加入你的队伍的人建立支持点特别有帮助，并且是说服新兵加入你的重要方式（稍后会详细介绍），因为你无法在战斗中与他们建立支持。
你最终将解锁竞技场训练，在那里你可以指派两名战士以各种方式相互训练。这将提高双方战士对武器、魔法或动作类型的掌握，同时也为他们提供彼此的支持点。竞技场训练是让角色为更高级的战斗课程做好准备的最有价值的方法。另外，它每周都可用，所以不要忘记每隔一段时间回到 Dagsion 来利用它。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/3-renown-1790796232673.jpg
提高你的声誉
每个主角在游戏初期到达 Dagsion 后都会了解“声望”，这基本上是衡量你在这座城市的知名度的统计数据。提高你的声望会在一定的阈值上增加重要的提升，使招募更多角色成为可能，这是《财富之网》核心游戏循环的重要组成部分。
所有主角都可以接受 Dagsion 各地的人们发出的子任务，其中大部分任务将带你到世界地图上寻找物品或消灭某些敌人。这些子任务都会获得声望，并且都有截止日期，但它们通常都很宽容，所以你应该有足够的时间来完成所有这些任务。
旁白是该标准的例外。这些是更重要的支线任务，扩展了各个角色的故事。 《火焰之纹章》的老玩家可能已经熟悉了旁白，但《财富的编织》中对旁白的处理方式与该系列的其他部分不同。只有在设定的时间内与《Dagsion》中的正确角色交谈后，你才能开始一个旁白，而且旁白的截止日期很严格（在最极端的情况下，在迪特里希的路径上有一个你只能在一个特定的日期获得）。

这可能是一个问题，因为您可能会在世界地图上花费很长一段时间，然后就过了截止日期，甚至没有意识到有旁白可用。您不会收到任何游戏内通知，您只需在正确的日期到达 Dagsion 即可。完成一段旁白可以让你获得 20,000 金币、一堆声望，并解锁某些角色的招募，所以它们非常值得。我通常不建议在指南的帮助下进行游戏，但我认为在这方面最好事先查找信息。您需要了解旁白可用的日期，以便您可以做出相应的计划。幸运的是，IGN 对所有主角的约会进行了完整的细分。
您还可以通过拜访达格森神庙中的神灵来赢得声望。这在游戏早期就可用，但很容易忘记，因为你没有得到提醒。地图上有每个神的神庙的图标。您可能会注意到，在某些日子里，其中一个图标是黄色的，这意味着上帝亲自在那里并且可以拜访。如果你继续与同一个神聊天，他们会和你变得亲密，并可能透露一些关于他们自己或关于世界的知识的额外信息。

虽然完成支线任务和旁白是每个人获得声望的基本方式，但每个主角还有一个额外的独特声望。蔡的任务包括做更多的任务，称为仁慈任务。迪特里希可以随时召唤敌人参加战斗，也可以在地牢中与决斗者窃取他们的战斗艺术。西奥多拉收到资源请求，允许她用你收集的物品换取声望。对于勒达（Leda），请记得在每章开头检查达格西翁（Dagsion）的酒馆。她将在世界地图上的某些城市收到新的表演请求，在那里她可以跳舞以立即获得数千金币和数百声望。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/30/4-materials-1790796294987.jpg
注意你的材料
角色等级和职业进展在《财富之网》中显然很重要，但不要忘记他们的装备。你将从木制武器开始，但军械库将很快添加更强大的青铜和铁版本。您应该尽快升级。
在第 6 章中，无论你走哪条路，你都会被介绍给铁匠。主要的一座位于达格西翁，但世界地图上的一些较大的城镇也会有一座。它们允许你花钱和锻造材料来升级你的武器，基本武器只需要锻造石，而更专业的装备则需要独特的材料。
你可以在世界地图上收集这些材料，但找到它们的最佳地点是矿井。这些地牢里有水晶矿藏，你可以粉碎它们，保证你能获得锻造材料。正如你所期望的，更高级别的矿井将有更多独特的材料，你可以一次收集到一堆。
地下城里也充满了你可以通过攻击粉碎的盒子和桶，而那些装有物品的盒子和桶上会有金色的闪光。你可以通过这种方式获得各种材料，包括石头和食物。

news.title: 开发者称《GTA 6》应该为更昂贵的游戏“开辟道路”
news.summary: Rockstar's GTA 6 is priced at $80 for its standard edition. Another voice has come forward to say they hope ot

content.v: Rockstar's GTA 6 is priced at $80 for its standard edition. Another voice has come forward to say they hope other teams follow suit and charge more for new games to help the industry at a time when developers are closing up shop, cancelling games, and laying off developers on a regular basis.
Martin Klima, the co-founder of Kingdom Come developer Warhorse, told PC Gamer that raising unit prices would "help a lot," but "everybody's scared to death" to do it.

"Now, hopefully, GTA will blaze the trail, and it will allow us to increase the cost," he said, adding that Rockstar and Take-Two are among the only companies who can "afford, or who can dare" to raise prices in this way.
He added that price increases for new games are "long overdue and also necessary for this business to survive."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Ambrosia_05_3fee31.jpg?w=636

Take-Two was among the first big publishers to drive prices up from $60 to $70, kicking this off with NBA 2K21 in 2020. Numerous other publishers followed suit, and now $70 is the norm. Defending the price increase, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick said production costs increased by 300%.

Former PlayStation executive Shawn Layden said in 2025 that the price of new games should have gone up with every new console generation for the past 20 years. That largely did not happen, and now the industry is worse off for it, he said.

“I think it’s because everyone’s afraid,” he told GI.biz . “No one wants to be the first one to raise the price, because you’re afraid to lose traffic. So what you do is you just end up eating into your operating income, your profit margin.”

“There were more sports cars in the parking lot in the PS1 era than there were in the PS4 era, because if you’re selling 20 million units at $60 for something that only cost you $10 million to make, that’s different than selling 20 million units at $60 for something that cost you $160 million to make.”
To help make up the difference, developers have hawked things like microtransactions, DLC, and battle passes . If more games go up in price, those trends will likely continue, too.
Before GTA 6's price was revealed, a Bank of America stock analyst said Take-Two should charge $80 to help spur other publishers to follow suit .
We already have $80 games, as Nintendo charges $80 for Mario Kart World, saying the game's ambition justifies the price tag .

Every game is priced differently, even within the same publisher, as Take-Two launched Mafia: The Old Country for $50– to great success . For its part, Nintendo's newly released F ire Emblem: Fortune's Weave costs $80 for its physical edition or $70 for its digital counterpart.

GTA 6, which releases on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, also has a $100 Ultimate Edition and a $400 collector's edition that does not include the game. Zelnick said earlier this year that Rockstar could have leveraged the monumental demand for GTA 6 to c harge a higher price to consumers , but chose not to.

In addition to the mountains of money Rockstar and Take-Two are due to make off GTA 6 game sales, the game is likely to eventually have some kind of new version of GTA Online, and that's no doubt going to print money .

news.title: GTA 6 将我们生活的荒谬世界变成了 11 个
news.summary: Video games are usually a few steps removed from reality, but with Grand Theft Auto 6 , developer Rockstar Gam

content.v: Video games are usually a few steps removed from reality, but with Grand Theft Auto 6 , developer Rockstar Games aims to reflect and amplify the current state of the world with an "over the top" experience. As seen in the trailers and gameplay previews so far, GTA 6 is a contemporary game about doing whatever it takes to make it to the top, and that pursuit of fame and glory is often bookended by shootouts, car chases, and explosions in its Bonnie and Clyde narrative.

"If you are going to put all this effort into creating a version of today’s world, it has to be more over the top, more insane, more in your face," senior VP of narrative Rupert Humphries said to Love Magazine . "Otherwise, you could just go outside and live in the real world."

Humphries also described the world of GTA 6 as "a pressure cooker for all kinds of insanity," as the protagonists, Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, are polar opposites. Game writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern described Lucina as an ambitious go-getter who'll do anything to get the life she dreams of, while Jason is bound by life's circumstances. "We wanted both protagonists to be vulnerable, tough, flawed, right sometimes, wrong sometimes, able to learn from each other," Gauvey-Kern said.

GTA 6 is also making some big changes to the franchise formula, as getting out of trouble won't be as easy as hiding in an alley and waiting for your wanted level to drop. Actions have consequences, and with the cops being much smarter and more persistent, players will have to be more cunning before they embark on a crime spree. The relationship between Jason and Lucia is also surprisingly more nuanced and deeper than you think, and it'll be a major part of the overall GTA 6 experience when the game launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

With the wait almost over, the marketing machine for GTA 6 has begun to get into gear. Advertising has already taken over a Miami stadium , and the NBA's Miami Heat have announced they'll wear GTA 6-inspired jerseys when they face off against the Milwaukee Bucks on November 18. Rockstar Games also announced a $400 GTA 6 Collector's Edition last week; while it doesn't include the game, it does include various trinkets typically associated with users of the devil's dandruff.

news.title: MTG 的霍比特人卡是最接近拥有稀有托尔金纪念品的东西，非常适合收藏家
news.summary: Here's why Magic: The Gathering’s small-ish Hobbit set somehow surpasses the massive Lord of the Rings crossov

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/02/img-2807-1790937934930.JPG

For the second time, and likely the last, Magic: The Gathering has taken players back to Middle-Earth with its The Hobbit set (its fifth of the year, if you can believe it), and it’s been pretty great.

That’s perhaps to be expected since the original book laid out a lot of what we consider fantasy tropes. Dragons, goblins, dwarves, and more are represented here in a smaller set than the Lord of the Rings one, all of which have gone on to inspire Magic cards in their own right.

Still, given how tricky it can be to get some products, there’s a good chance that finding Hobbit items can feel like searching for the Arkenstone in Smaug’s treasure hoard. And yet, it feels like, in a way, that’s kind of the point.
Tolkien Collectors Will Love The Hobbit Set
J.R.R. Tolkien’s influence on the world of fantasy cannot be overstated, and there’s a reason that so many early editions of his works have fetched colossal sums of money.
As an example, back in 2025, a fully signed Lord of the Rings first-edition set sold for around £287,700 (or $337,000). That marks the high point of spending, but it’s not an outlier by any stretch.
An unsigned first edition of the book also sold in 2025 for $250,000, while a collection of manuscripts from the author that includes notes written in Elvish has sold for over $200,000, too.

Naturally, memorabilia sells big, too, notably from Peter Jackson’s iconic movies. Props, costumes, and limited-edition art prints fetch piles of gold to make a covetous dragon blush, and that includes pieces from The Hobbit movies, too.
Of course, those figures are colossal compared to the price of even the most expensive cards in The Hobbit set , but there’s crossover there, too.

Whereas the Lord of the Rings set offered full art cards with a slick border treatment that highlighted the series’ characters across heroes and villains, The Hobbit leans into the series’ literary origins with book cover-inspired designs that carry a “well-read” look that makes them feel unique amongst Magic’s wide-ranging treatment offerings.

This writer was lucky enough to pack Gandalf, Goblins’ Bane and Smaug, Wicked Worm in the treatment, and they’ve almost instantly become two of my favorite Magic cards I own. There’s just something about the way they look textured that makes them feel like the latest in a long line of Tolkien memorabilia.
In fact, I’d go so far as to say that these are my favorite treatments we’ve received in years - and an ideal inclusion for any serious collector.
That doesn’t make it any easier to find the cards, mind…

news.title: 5年后，Netflix还会涉足游戏领域吗？这是首席执行官所说的
news.summary: Netflix has been experimenting with video games for a while, but is the streaming giant going to eventually dr

content.v: Netflix has been experimenting with video games for a while, but is the streaming giant going to eventually drop out of gaming? That's the question Bloomberg's Lucas Shaw put to Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos at the Screentime event this week .

Regarding whether Netflix will still host games in five years, Sarandos said, "I think so." He said Netflix's push into mobile gaming was "a gateway to cloud gaming," which is something Netflix is "much more interested in."

Netflix hosts a variety of mobile games, including Red Dead Redemption, Sonic Mania Plus, and RollerCoaster Tycoon Touch, just to name a few. The games are included with a Netflix membership and have no ads. Netflix also hosts streaming games that can be played on your TV, and they are more family- and party-focused.

Netflix's gaming ambitions have bounced around over the years. At one point, the company wanted to make big, AAA games, and hired some big names to get it done. However, Netflix later wound down these efforts , closing studios and laying off staff in the process, leading many to wonder what Netflix's ambition for video games actually was.

Sarandos said cloud gaming makes more sense for Netflix "in a post-console world." He didn't elaborate here, but it sounds like he's talking about a future where more and more people play games without dedicated hardware like a PlayStation, Xbox, or Switch console. All of those systems have gone up in price in recent times due to AI-fueled component and memory issues, along with bigger global macroeconomic trends.

The cloud gaming market hasn't popped the way some have predicted, but Sarandos isn't the only person who is optimistic about the future potential. Strauss Zelnick, the head of GTA 6 owner Take-Two recently said , "I think we'll be in commercial streaming mode within three years."
Sarandos said there will be "all kinds of opportunities for gaming on the television," and the executive said Netflix wanted to be "early invested in that."
"I like it for IP extension. I certainly like it for brand value, for people who want to spend time on that screen gaming instead of watching, then we have an option for them," he said.

Also in the interview, Sarandos was asked if Netflix would again reach into its coffers to buy a large-scale gaming company to help its gaming ambitions become realized faster. The interviewer asked if Netflix could buy Take-Two or Xbox, and Sarandos said it doesn't have any specific plans to buy more gaming studios, though he's not ruling anything out either. For what it's worth, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma recently said Xbox is not for sale , while Take-Two selling itself would be shocking.

Sarandos said Netflix prefers to grow organically instead of buying companies to spur growth. Of course, this isn't a hard-and-fast rule, as evidenced by Netflix offering to buy Warner Bros. Discover for many billions of dollars before Paramount swooped in and made a deal. He said Netflix went after WBD because the company was "so clean" and contained only the elements and assets of the business that Netflix actually wanted, and that was rare.
Netflix will look at other opportunities to buy game studios if they complement the company's wider business goals, Sarandos said.
In other news about cloud gaming, Microsoft has reportedly canceled its new controller for it , ahead of price hikes to the service soon .

Netflix has also said it's still very early days for its gaming output, saying the company has “tons more work to do." Netflix's financial investment in gaming is minuscule relative to its other business areas, and management sees gaming as a "significant market opportunity." Netflix investors no doubt want to see Netflix find new ways to make money; after all, Netflix stock has crashed more than 25% in 2026 so far.

news.title: 《控制:共振》玩家评测：绿美迪的翻身大作

content.v: 你如果没玩过前作的话并没关系，但是你可能会感觉太多故事内容一下子砸到你了。
美国研究超自然的部门叫FBC（the Federal Bureau of Control，联邦控制局），他们弄来一个小孩儿做研究，小孩儿叫Dylan Faden，然而为了推进科学，他们对待这个6号实验品越来越不仁道，而且急功近利了。
结果几年后，这个6号实验品挣脱控制，被Hiss控制了，开始尝试突破这个FBC的控制。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/09/27/origin_13660617_4842208.jpg
6号在第一天就杀了500多人。
为了调查父母死亡真相和寻找自己的弟弟的Jesse Faden也正好在弟弟逃出挣脱后成为了FBC的负责人。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/09/27/origin_13660617_4842203.jpg
最后在一代的故事里，姐姐把Hiss打败了，让弟弟挣脱了控制，弟弟从此进入昏迷。
第一代Control是2019年发售的，Remedy可能是为了演员年龄符合故事需求，总是把现实和游戏里的时间同步。
所以在故事里，弟弟昏迷了7年，这一醒来，大事不妙，FBC总部，也就是所谓的“最老的房子”（The Oldest House）门口破了一个大洞。
整个纽约完犊子了···而且姐姐也不见了。
主角也成了一代大反派，Dylan Faden
这一段开局我拿最高画质录制了32：9的开场，没有解说，有兴趣的可以看一下：
控制：共振 最高画质32：9无解说
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/09/27/origin_13660617_4842204.jpg
你如果不知道为什么所有人要不就怕你，要不就恨你恨的咬牙切齿，那···建议你玩一下一代你就知道了。
熟悉Remedy的玩家要知道这个组有三个特点：
1. 故事一直都是业界顶级
2. 总是能用自研引擎隐藏自己其实制作成本不高（相对）而假装成一个AAA作品
3. 这么多年下来，公司财务依然还是比较脆弱（相对），也就是没挣到什么钱
先说 故事 吧，故事这次很多人说这个游戏故事估计不行，因为不是Sam Lake参与的故事。
还有人说这个游戏Sam Lake没碰，这个其实也不对，Sam Lake本名叫Sami Järvi，他依然是Creative Director，换了名字很多人没认出来。
但是这个游戏的Game Director是Mikael Kasurinen，剧本是Ashley Smith。
Mikael Kasurinen其实也是Remedy大神之一。
他也是初代Control的Game Director，此外还参与了Max Payne 2，Alan Wake和Quantum Break等作品。而且我玩了这么久，这一次故事也相当精彩。
在故事线上···
我先给大家跪下了···
我发现我24年3月写的Alan Wake的故事整理，第二代的故事忘记补完了，拖稿一拖就是2年多···我错了
我先认错，之后我会简单串烧一下整个两个IP的故事线，就现在来说，简单的讲：
Alan Wake 1 =》 American Nightmare / Alan 被困 =》 Control 的 Ordinary/Faden/FBC =》 Control 主线 =》AWE DLC =》 Alan Wake 2 =》 Night Springs =》 Lake House =》 CONTROL Resonant
整个Remedy Universe的故事可以说是目前游戏作品里最好的一个设定之一。
你需要非常能理解现实扭曲，多元宇宙，时间压缩等概念，才能很好的去理解这个系列。
这一代你不需要玩过前作就可以玩，只不过你真的对游戏故事不熟悉的话，游戏里发生的事情会把你脑子搞爆炸。
引擎 方面
他们还是用从《Quantum Break》开始就使用的自研Northlight Engine。
这一次我认为这个游戏的画面表现可能冲到了这个引擎的极限了，我敢保证这个游戏有许多场景会让你非常 非常的震撼 。
游戏除非长距离走传送门，不然一般都不会有太多读盘。
不是不读盘，是都隐藏的很好。
每次主角抱着头，一个头疼的表情，然后忽然画面上全是鲜血的闪回，这其实就是在隐藏读盘。
接下来会有场景变换了。
当年玩《Dishonored 2》，有那么一关可以用一个东西切换不同时间，进行实时的地图结构切换。
当时把我震撼了。
但是在本作（打字麻烦···以下简称CR）里，地图的场景切换简直被用到了最夸张的地步。
你一会儿走在纽约街上， 忽然一下进入了一个无底洞，周围整个世界都旋转了起来···画面的酷炫程度非常夸张。
但这也很好的掩盖了其实游戏就是一个箱庭式小地图自由探索，进行地图间的电梯啊，爬行啊，许多都是掩盖读盘的桥段，让你觉得是无缝衔接。
说到钱 ，Remedy是有财报公布的，所以他们的惨大家都能看到。
直到现在，他们的项目还是自己没钱做，都是要跪求发行商出钱才能出作品。
2019年的Control开发成本3000万欧元，算是他们当时最大体量的制作了，其中一半的钱是505拿的。
回本后Remedy拿45%的利润，2年后游戏在2021年卖了300万份，营收超过7000万欧，但Remedy拿到手的钱很少。
毕竟Steam扣掉3成，剩下一半儿多505要拿走，回本是回本了，但是没赚什么钱。
Alan Wake 2则是Epic承担开发成本和营销成本，大家当年不都抱怨这个游戏为什么 Epic独占 吗？
结果这么厉害的一个超高分作品就硬是没人买，Epic的平台实在是不行，好游戏也救不过来。
总之后来AW2直到14个月才官宣收回来所有开发成本，后面的销售利润50%会到Remedy。
反正在玩家心中，我相信Remedy名声其实不错，目前来看，不管作品卖的好不好，他们作品大部分都是精品。
但实际上，这个组其实并不是那种财大气粗自己能掏出钱做一个大体量AAA的团队。
虽然是300多快400人的团队，但是感觉一直在挣扎。
这一次的《控制：共振》开发成本50M，已经是他们历史上最大的项目了，但也是一个豪赌。赌注巨大
2024年的时候，Remedy从505手里把Control、Control 2、FBC: Firebreak 以及未来 Control 产品的发行、营销、分销等权利全部买回来，花了1700万欧元。
然后开始和美国影视游戏的独立游戏公司Annapurna（安纳布尔纳影业）合作。

news.title: 据报道 Pokémon TCG 将于 2027 年推出首个情人节系列
news.summary: Pokémon TCG is reportedly launching its first-ever Valentine's Day box set on January 27, 2027, featuring mini

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/02/pokemon-valentine-set-tcg-rumor-1790952987076.png
The Pokémon Company is intending to launch the franchise's very first dedicated Valentine's Day collection on January 27, 2027, according to a recent report from Pokébeach .

While the Valentine set is yet to be officially confirmed, the leaks reportedly suggest that the "Pokémon TCG Valentine’s Box" will be similar in practice to the popular Trick or Trade Halloween series, rather than a full expansion release like Pokémon TCG's Delta Reign or Chaos Rising expansions.

These seasonal sets typically come in compact foil packs containing three cards, alongside sticker sheets. The Halloween releases were given their own pumpkin-stamped Pikachu, so I'd put good money on the Valentine's version getting some kind of suitably pink Pika stamp.

The Trick or Trade range was originally designed as a way for kids to hand out Pokémon cards while trick-or-treating, effectively giving them a Pokémon-themed alternative to candy. Given how expensive some Halloween sweets have become, perhaps the cards aren't such a bad substitute.

The reported Valentine's Box appears to be taking a similar approach, with the packaging and packs seemingly designed around giving cards to friends or handing them out in the classroom. The box is also apparently designed to fold into a little cardboard mailbox, allowing cards to be handed out to classmates in the same way kids might exchange Valentine's cards at school.
That's a cute idea, although given the current state of the Pokémon TCG market, I'm not entirely convinced every box will make it into the hands of an actual child.

Previous seasonal releases have generally focused on reprinted cards rather than introducing a bunch of new full-art cards, but that hasn't stopped sealed products from holding surprisingly strong secondary-market value. The Trick or Trade BOOster Bundle (last seen in 2025), for example, contains 40 mini packs with three cards apiece, and currently has a market value of around $75.99 at TCGplayer.

That makes the potential Valentine's release one to keep an eye on, particularly if it proves to be another limited seasonal product. Previous holiday releases have sold out well ahead of launch, so the real competition could come when preorders eventually open.

There's also currently no word on which Pokémon will take centre stage in the mini set. My vote would be Enamorus, although Fairy-type Pokémon aren't currently part of the TCG's standard format... Yet.

I’d also love to see Sylveon - its pink color scheme and cute ribbons would be perfect. Plus, it evolves by friendship! Other options could be Audino and Blissey, since both are linked with care and kindness - qualities that suit Valentine's Day well- or even Pikachu in loveheart-themed clothing might also show up.

Sylveon would also be an obvious choice. Its pink colour scheme and ribbons are practically made for Valentine's Day, while the fact that it evolves through friendship feels particularly appropriate. Audino and Blissey could also fit the theme nicely given their associations with care and kindness, while a loveheart-themed Pikachu would hardly come as a surprise.

news.title: 暴雪在《魔兽世界：永远》中添加了深受喜爱的“凯尔失踪”任务
news.summary: For as much as World of Warcraft Forever has been making an effort to preserve the vanilla WoW experience, the

content.v: For as much as World of Warcraft Forever has been making an effort to preserve the vanilla WoW experience, there are just some things in the game's history that must be added, and the quest 'Kyle's Gone Missing!' is one of them. And Blizzard just added it to Forever.

'Kyle's Gone Missing!' was added during the Burning Crusade expansion through a Make-a-Wish campaign in 2007 for Ezra Chatterton , who was diagnosed with brain cancer earlier that year. Chatterton, who went by the in-game name of Ephoenix, voiced the quest-giver, Ahab Wheathoof, and had his dog Kyle added to the game, which players were then tasked with finding. The quest went live in patch 2.1.2 on June 19, 2007, and has been in the game ever since.

Sadly, a little over a year later, in October 2008, Chatterton passed away at the age of 12 . The quest has remained a beloved part of the game ever since, and Chatterton has also been referenced multiple times, with Blizzard re-naming the Elder of Thunderbluff (who shows up during the annual Lunar Festival) after him in Wrath of the Lich King.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/02/image-1-1790951982452.webp

But because the quest was added during The Burning Crusade, it's not part of the original game, which meant it wouldn't be in World of Warcraft Forever – even if the zone where the quest takes place is the Tauren starting zone. But, after players asked Blizzard to bring the quest to Forever, it's officially been added.

Blizzard added the patch after players asked for it in the forums, when user Nyaria posted saying, "My Husband was very sad that the Make a Wish Quest involving Kyle wasn’t in Mulgore." They even acknowledged that it doesn't fit the 'Vanilla-only' ethos, but stood by it, saying, "Yes it wasn’t added until TBC, but this is WoW: Forever, we already have new quests added in, and it was a cute little quest, and a Make a Wish addition for a poor kid."

Luckily, shortly after that thread was posted Blizzard community manager Kaivax simply posted: "We're working on it. Stay tuned." The entire rest of the thread is full of players thanking Kaivax and the rest of the Forever team for adding the quest. One player, Ikory, claimed to have been a Make-a-Wish kid who survived and thanked Blizzard in a long post , which they signed off with: "I spent 30 years in crippling pain, with a failing heart, that had to be repaired every few years. I am a survivor. I was that kid who was supposed to die. Now I have a freaken PhD. I lived. Make-A-Wish helped me have hope as a kid. I got my wish. I’m glad Ezra got his wish. Thank you Blizzard for still caring about us Make-A-Wish kids after all these years."
Now, just four days later, the quest is officially live in the World of Warcraft beta, as a part of the October 1 patch .

Johnny Cash, the Blizzard Principal Designer who added the quest, posted on X/Twitter , saying "I had the honor and privilege of bringing "Kyle's Gone Missing!" into WoW: Forever. Ezra Chatterton was an enormous WoW fan, the creator and voice actor behind Ahab Wheathoof, and the creator of Kyle. A tear was shed during this one, my friends. Rest in peace, Ezra."

The quest isn't hard to get to, especially if you start off as a Tauren. Ezra's NPC is in Bloodhoof Village, which is the first town you get to while questing in Mulgore. You can pick up the quest as soon as you hit level 5, and you'll need to hunt down plainstriders (giant ostrich-looking things) until you get Tender Strider Meat, which you will then feed Kyle to get him to return home.

It's nice to see that while Blizzard has been pretty adamant about keeping the spirit of Classic World of Warcraft alive in Forever, it's willing to add a little wiggle room to add beloved pieces of WoW history like this quest. For as much as World of Warcraft has a reputation for gold selling and general toxicity , it's moments like this that remind me just how magical this game is, and how much it means to so many people.

news.title: Fami 通《索尼克》系列诞生 35 周年纪念访谈
news.summary: 以广为人知的刺猬“索尼克”为主角《索尼克》系列即将在 2026 年迎来诞生的 35 周年。 除了游戏，该系列也在电影、动画、周边等多个领域广泛布局，最近甚至还短暂加入了职业电竞战队“ZETA DIVISION”的创作者部

content.v: 以广为人知的刺猬“索尼克”为主角《索尼克》系列即将在 2026 年迎来诞生的 35 周年。
除了游戏，该系列也在电影、动画、周边等多个领域广泛布局，最近甚至还短暂加入了职业电竞战队“ZETA DIVISION”的创作者部门。这个极具速度感与意外性的 IP，始终在为粉丝们带来欢乐。
前不久，《Fami 通》编辑对长期参与《索尼克》系列的制作人饭冢隆先生进行了专访，向他询问了系列发展历程、制定各项企划的初衷以及未来的发展方向。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/881337a59f4fac917d202e57e61d65b8/
饭冢隆 (下文简称为饭冢） 《索尼克》系列综合制作人。1992年加入世嘉，此后参与了多款《索尼克》游戏的制作。
跨越“是否新作已经没有必要了？”的质疑低谷
—— 索尼克系列迎来了诞生的 35 周年，您现在的心情如何？
饭冢： 最直观的感受就是“居然已经过去 35 年了啊”。这期间虽然有过辉煌的时刻，但在经历低谷时，甚至有人对我说过“《索尼克》已经不需要再出新作了吧”。
跨越重重波折，一直苦苦支撑的《索尼克》现在终于有一种要迎来腾飞的感觉了，这真的是一个很棒的 35 周年。
—— 在此过程中，您印象最深的事是什么呢？
饭冢： 毕竟过去了 35 年，发生的事情实在太多了。如果硬要说的话，最能带来感动和成就感的那就是电影化吧。和好莱坞演员一起走在红毯上时，我发自内心地产生了一种“终于走到这一步了”的情绪。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/c2e5fc7d9b592d274f3b4465ed4aef32/
能够在好莱坞电影产业中取得成功的游戏 IP 屈指可数，而《索尼克》系列目前已经制作到了第三部，2027 年还将上映第四部。此外还制作了衍生剧集《纳克鲁斯》。能够实现如此多维度的拓展，我认为是相当值得骄傲的。
—— 您觉得积极进行包括电影在内的多媒体拓展有成效吗？
饭冢： 以电影和动画为首，包含周边商品、线下活动、实景娱乐等业务在内的全方位拓展真的称得上是多管齐下，我深切感受到《索尼克》这个品牌正在广泛渗透到各种人群当中。我个人的工作内容重心理所当然还是游戏制作，但在精力分配上，参与游戏以外的工作时间的确是变多了。
不过随着近年来 IP 人气持续攀升，在谈联动合作时和其他大厂的沟通也变得更加顺畅，我觉得我们正处于一个极其良好的发展势头当中。
—— 原来如此。顺便问一下，关于海外市场的拓展情况如何？
饭冢： 《索尼克》与其他日本 IP 不同，它从一开始就是一个着眼于全球市场的 IP。在世嘉内部，最早进行本地化和多语言支持的游戏也是《索尼克》，直到今天欧美市场依然是我们绝对的主力。
未来，我们会努力将《索尼克》推广到欧美以外的地区，以日本为中心，涵盖韩国、中国、东南亚等亚洲市场。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/b0e62680356508931da6838da551c641/
—— 也就是一种以海外为起点，然后“反向输入”回来的形式。
饭冢： 没错。最初在 1991 年发售的《刺猬索尼克》就是作为一款拉动 MD（在海外被称为 GENESIS）主机销量的护航大作。
当时开发团队瞄准的就是欧美市场，比如“绿色山丘”这个关卡，便是利用美国加利福尼亚的棕榈树和蓝天等印象制作而成的。
—— 索尼克的性格也非常美式呢。
饭冢： 日本的英雄大多是所谓的“乖宝宝”，但索尼克不是。他是一个比起区分善恶，更倾向于 “只要是自己想做的事，总之先干了再说”的性格。他正是基于这种英雄形象的差异化意识而塑造出的角色。
除了“玩”还要照顾到“看”
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/73ac47c055c2606caca8627dc700c97d/
—— 在各种企划中，加入 ZETA DIVISION 实在让人出乎意料。请问这是怎么促成的？
饭冢： 正如刚才提到的，这是让《索尼克》在日本及亚洲地区普及的举措之一，是世嘉主动提出了“能不能让索尼克和你们一起搞点有趣的企划？”
因为迄今为止常规的宣发手段都不太成功，所以我们正在不断试错，尝试从多个角度让不同圈层的人了解这个 IP。加入 ZETA DIVISION 是这样，与 YouTuber、VTuber 的合作也是出于同样的考量。
(※2026年7月8日宣布加入 ZETA DIVISION。在 9月20日与 k4sen 先生共同登上 TGS 2026 舞台后，宣布退团。)
—— 这类的联动合作，是否也有向游戏玩家之外的“云玩家”进行传播的意图？
饭冢： 是的，我认为很大程度上“根本不知道这游戏”或者“从来没见过这游戏” 是在以日本为首的亚洲地区难以渗透的原因之一。
购买游戏并亲自去游玩的门槛相对较高，但只是看的话就非常简单了。我们认为从游戏实况等其他渠道让大家知晓它的存在，也是一个极佳的入口。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/1f71820a98070567b37f6129351eac42/
—— 在开发游戏时，你们也会刻意注重“观赏性或直播效果”吗？
饭冢： 近年来我们开始越来越注重这一点了。打造“玩起来有趣的游戏”是我们一直以来的追求，但现在我们也会加入一些帅气的过场动画，融入那些让人光看着就觉得 “这游戏看起来很好玩”的要素。
硬件性能的提升固然是一个重要因素，但我们以前在开发时很少去考虑“作为视频或影像是否具有视觉冲击力”这一点。
关于未来的动向
—— 请谈谈《索尼克》系列未来的发展计划，以及接下来准备推出的企划吧。
饭冢： 首先关于《索尼克赛车 交叉世界》，我们已经公布了第 2 赛季会与《哥斯拉》和《新世纪福音战士》联动。接下来会用 1 年的时间持续推出第 2 赛季（共 6 弹）的更新，请大家拭目以待。
—— 《索尼克赛车 交叉世界》每次公布的联动都让人惊掉下巴，请问你们选择联动对象的标准是什么？
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/dabcb5b367d2751470837ac0814ff49c/
饭冢： 我们当然希望各联动作品的粉丝都能来玩我们的游戏，但对于已经购买了游戏的玩家，也希望他们能产生一种“接下来还会出什么呢？”的期待感。
我们不想做那种大家都能猜到的联动，而是希望通过提供意外性和惊喜，让玩家们能持续不断地玩下去，这也是我们决定联动对象的一大标准。毕竟是借用他人的 IP，所以我们始终在努力实现能让双方粉丝都满意的、高质量的联动。
—— 其他游戏还会有什么新动作呢？
饭冢： 《索尼克 Pico Park》也即将在 2026 年 11 月 12 日发售了，敬请期待。
除此之外的情报，目前还没有可以正式公布的内容。但我们团队始终保持着以 1 年后、2 年后为节点进行游戏开发的节奏，请大家满怀期待地等待我们的好消息。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/ce385926a9da8724e5edac3129151bdb/
—— 前几天公布了将在 Netflix 制作新的动画系列，请问这将是一部怎样的作品？
饭冢： 目前除了官方公告上提到的内容外，我们不能透露更多。唯一能说的就是这是一部 “儿童动画”。
本作与之前和 Netflix 合作制作的《索尼克 Prime》以及电影系列的目标受众不同。我们希望打造一部能让小学生和学龄前儿童开心观看的作品。
—— 最后，请对一直期待系列未来发展的粉丝们说点什么吧。
饭冢： 借着 35 周年纪念之际，我要向长久以来支持索尼克的各位致以最诚挚的感谢。未来我们会一直制作《索尼克》的新内容，2027 年第四部电影也将上映。接下来还会不断提供更多能让大家乐在其中的内容，所以今后也请大家继续支持《索尼克》！
原作者：Fami 通编辑部 翻译：奶油吐司车 编辑：熊猫命

news.title: 《网络奇兵 2 重制版》现已免费在 Epic Games Store 上架
news.summary: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster is currently free to claim on the Epic Games Store until October 8,

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/02/14/ss2-1739543581123.png

PC players can currently pick up System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster for free on the Epic Games Store until October 8, 2026. As with all of Epic's weekly freebies, anything you claim during the window stays in your library permanently. You'll need a free Epic Games account to claim System Shock 2, and the game is played through the Epic Games Launcher.
Nightdive Studios, the team behind a string of well-regarded classic revivals such as those for Quake and Star Wars: Dark Forces, released the 25th Anniversary Remaster in June 2025.
The update keeps the original design but modernises how it looks and plays, including the following changes:

The original System Shock 2 launched back in 1999, developed by Looking Glass Studios and Irrational Games, blending together an FPS shooter with the character building of an RPG. You wake from cryosleep aboard the faster-than-light ship Von Braun in the year 2114 with no memory of who you are, and the ship is overrun by hybrid mutants and hostile robots.

Its influence is hard to overstate. Many of the people behind it went on to make the BioShock games, which are often described as a spiritual successor to System Shock 2, and the game's blend of environmental storytelling and player choice has shaped plenty of what has followed. The original title garnered a 9/10 rating when it received an updated review. Now, this Epic Games Store deal offers a free way to revisit one of the most influential games ever made.

If the remaster whets your appetite, Nightdive also released a full remake of the first System Shock on PC in 2023, rebuilt with new HD visuals, updated controls and a revamped hacking system. It's a handy way to explore the series' roots, though System Shock 2 works perfectly well as a standalone adventure – that's currently $11.99 on Steam with a hefty 70% discount during the Autumn Sale .

Epic is also giving away Buried Stars this week, so it's worth heading to the store for both. It's an anime-style visual novel in which a group of contestants on a TV show must survive a mysterious attack. Like System Shock 2, it's available to claim until 8 October, and you can add both games to your library in a couple of clicks.

news.title: 索尼改进版 PS5 Slim 的制造成本可能会降低，但购买成本可能会降低
news.summary: It looks like Sony has quietly revised the PS5 console once again, with new internal changes across the (mothe

content.v: It looks like Sony has quietly revised the PS5 console once again, with new internal changes across the (mother)board. It's not clear when these new models came into service, but they seem to have entered circulation around the same time Sony released limited-edition Marvel's Wolverine PS5 consoles.

Spotted by Modyfikator89, longevity and repairability appear to be the key areas that Sony has focused on. The redesigned motherboard offers easier access to the CR2023 battery, the streamlined internal layout makes repairs less risky, and the hardware takes a page from the PS5 Pro playbook with refined liquid-metal containment and revised heatsink materials. In theory, the updated barrier around the processor die should keep the liquid metal better contained over time, ensuring stable thermal transfer performance even under intensive loads.

Sony has also moved to a newer, lower-cost HDMI retimer chip, which likely cuts down bill-of-materials costs and improves display signal stability. Overall, this will likely lower production costs while maintaining higher assembly yields, at a time when sourcing components has become more challenging. Companies routinely make stealth revisions to cut manufacturing costs, but unlike previous console generations that shrank and became cheaper over time, the PS5 has only gotten more expensive since it launched in November 2020.

When it first launched , the entry-level PS5 Digital Edition had an MSRP of $400, but in 2026, you can expect to pay $600 for one. The base model PS5 with a disc drive has increased from $500 to $650, while the PS5 Pro has shot up from $700 to $900. Sony is aiming to make the PS5 a better value proposition as it heads into the lucrative holiday season, after recently launching a new AI-upscaling technology for its base-model PS5s.

Only two of its exclusive games support it currently--Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei--and the technology will be released to more developers soon. By enabling the base PS5 to deliver sharper visuals through Quick Spectral Super Resolution, Sony offers a visual upgrade in select games without having to splash out on the more expensive PS5 Pro.

content.v: 10月2日，小红书开放世界冒险岛RED LAND正式开幕，上海杨浦复兴岛再次变身”痛岛”。早上不到10点，船台公园入口处已经排起了长队。这是RED LAND连续第二年落地复兴岛，活动将持续至10月6日。
相较去年，本届RED LAND规模全面升级：场地从8万平方米扩展至15万平方米，超过160个游戏及动漫IP登岛，双双翻倍。据官方介绍，本届五轮售票平均每轮20.6秒全部售罄，这场持续五天的同好狂欢，也成为今年国庆假期最受关注的青年潮流文化活动之一。
https://image.gcores.com/4a4c16ac9959f670816ea0f68e3b2725-1269-951.jpeg
160+个人气IP登岛，打造2.5次元“沉浸式开放世界”
走进复兴岛，巨幅人气角色气模簇拥着机械船台，身着各式cos装扮的玩家与岛民NPC穿梭往来，在这里，青年潮流文化与工业遗存交相辉映。
本届RED LAND阵容不仅集结了160+人气IP，也集齐了多个“首次”。米哈游旗下四款作品首次线下同框，其生活模拟游戏新作《星布谷地》迎来国内首次线下亮相；复联、X战警、神奇四侠与黑豹五座英雄巨像在《复仇者联盟5》展位全球首亮相，迪士尼旗下《疯狂动物城》则第一次把城外海选和后台实景搬到漫展现场。
阵容亮点之外，本届RED LAND延续“开放世界冒险岛”概念，岛上划分翻身时空港、重生试炼场、黄金海岸线三大区域，船台、仓库和集装箱均成为策展的一部分，玩家登岛即可解锁角色身份、在80多个展位里参与沉浸式互动，解锁专属剧情线。
来到翻身时空港，玩家可以去《王者荣耀》的“小王5A级农友度假区”打一场上星小赛，也可以来到如鸢的绣衣楼，在绣球与飞云的主理人游戏区对暗号盖章；可以登上《崩坏：星穹铁道》的银河主题“假日KTV”开唱，也可以拐进迪士尼动物城的展台，沉浸式参与“嚎叫最大声”和“伴舞选拔”的海选。
https://image.gcores.com/9b2a7b2430f98762d053449d231a2f30-1600-1066.jpeg
走进重生试炼场，这里则集结了从3A大作、解谜神作到卡牌竞技等一众游戏展位。解谜神作《锈湖》把 Vanderboom 宅邸整体搬上岛，让玩家第一视角穿行玄关、客厅、地窖逐一解密；拉瑞安的展位里，《神界：原罪2》的阿克斯城广场市集也被搬进现实，玩家逛累了还可以进酒馆桌游区和开发者聊天。
现场还专门设置了“独立游戏大食堂”展区，80多款独立游戏IP悉数亮相。 CD PROJEKT RED、拉瑞安工作室等国际知名厂商的制作人也亲临现场，与玩家面对面交流。

移步黄金海岸线，这里“港口感”十足，集装箱、码头元素与江岸空间，被改造成了滨水的“主题乐园带。暴雪游戏首次聚合魔兽世界、守望先锋、炉石传说三大IP，三座主题岛屿同场，吉安娜主题舞台剧每日开演；《鸣潮》把东方灯会“朝月节”搬到江边，每晚和用户一起点亮电子“孔明灯”。到了下午5点半，全岛还将切换夜场模式，开启夜间专属玩法。《遗忘之海》的7米高“王女”夜航派对、逆水寒连开五夜的“星梦舞会”，无不渲染着夜晚的乐园氛围。
https://image.gcores.com/c35dba234b834be8792454503a5d3451-1600-1067.png
全新亮相的冒险者营地，则以”五天五主题”模式，承接cos、谷子、国风、卡牌等圈层同好线下的交流场。白天，“次元载具试驾会”、“二次元广播体操”等主题团建轮番上演；入夜后，营地切换为月光舞台歌友会，国风、热血竞技、经典共鸣等主题演出依次登场。
正如RED LAND发起人，小红社区市场部负责人白板所说：“我们希望用户走进每一个展位时，感受到的不只是一个展台，而是一个真正可以进入、可以互动的世界。”
首创游戏二次元花车巡游，让同好成为造梦的主角
更重要的是，在RED LAND，游戏二次元爱好者不只是体验者，也是这场线下同好节日的创造者。
本届RED LAND推出全球首个大型游戏二次元花车巡游。每天傍晚，巡游沿”冒险者大道”进行。官方头车领航，蛋仔派对、逆水寒、心动小镇、无畏契约、永劫无间等IP花车随行，沿线设有角色互动和隐藏彩蛋。
https://image.gcores.com/e67cb5a630e6a8206ceef837df0a1096-1600-1200.jpeg
巡游队伍中最具特色的，是首次开放的”主角方阵”——约150位通过社区报名的用户，带着自己手搓的花车和载具加入巡游：有人把平衡车改装成哪吒风火轮，有人蹬三轮，有人则手搓了一架蜘蛛侠主题的机械花车。
“白天，用户在不同IP和区域中探索；傍晚，我们希望用一场巡游，为所有人创造一个共同汇合、共同经历、共同记住的时刻。”白板表示，“在这里，同好不是游客，而是主角。”
https://image.gcores.com/08437aae815d6df97678cfabcd9b31fa-1620-1080.jpeg
这一用户共创的理念贯穿全岛。另一个RED LAND的原创设定岛民NPC，也带有浓重的共创色彩。作为“开放世界冒险岛”的原住民，岛民NPC栖居在岛屿的各个角落，迎接每一位登岛的玩家，和他们聊天、交换无料，甚至倾诉心事，为玩家创造沉浸式的互动体验。
https://image.gcores.com/b5e092f7b3cfba1ae11549ab90ffb537-1620-1079.jpeg
据官方介绍，今年岛民NPC从34位增至54位，所有扮演者也全部来自社区里的爱好者。去年火爆出圈的小菜农裘球，今年自己申请连任，去年散场时与她隔着人群对视落泪的那位用户，她至今记得；同样返场的星星今年来到黄金海岸线当菜农，用户送她的手持小电扇和宝丽来照片，如今还放在她家里。大学老师墨瓜则连夜从江西赶来上海，只为在线下治愈同好们的疲惫。
“RED LAND不是一个完全设定好的漫展，而是一个同好共创的社区线下节日。”白板说，“无论是岛民NPC，还是花车的主角方阵，他们都是社区里的游戏二次元爱好者，在社区里相遇，又因此来到线下，一起创造出了这五天的开放世界。”
线上社区文化，激发线下真实生活
RED LAND的持续升温，依托于社区里游戏二次元人群的快速成长。小红书社区游戏二次元业务负责人萤火透露，过去一年，游戏、二次元相关笔记的发布规模在站内所有兴趣垂类中位列第一和第四；游戏相关月活用户已突破1.2亿，二次元兴趣人群规模达1.37亿，同人、OC、cos团建等原生趋势发布量同比快速增长。
“这一代年轻人的文化，不只在消费中被看见，更在理解与表达中被共同创造。”萤火表示，新一代的游戏二次元爱好者不再满足于消费内容，而是通过cos、同人、OC、角色庆生等方式表达自我，把虚拟的热爱过成真实的生活。这也正是小红书承载的游戏二次元社区文化——即将虚拟文化和真实线下生活相结合的2.5次元生活方式。
如今，小红书正在成为年轻一代2.5次元新文化、新趋势、新人群的生长聚集地，RED LAND正是这种2.5次元生活方式的线下集中呈现。OC创作者津贺林吾专程从美国飞来，带着自制OC“小苹果”的制品与用户无料交换；社区原生创作者超级猫猫兽扮成自己的OC小猫逛展，开起了免费的拍照亭。
官方数据显示，此次参与RED LAND的购票用户，八成来自上海以外的地区。其中最远的IP，来自约19000公里外的阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯。这些同好们，因兴趣在线上社区聚集，也因为社区的链接，而在线下集体奔赴，在真实生活里相遇。
https://image.gcores.com/4ae092639adca2f9d7892ce7143bb404-1079-1619.jpeg
花车巡游的主角方阵中，有00后的工科大学生，通过社区组建了七人的同好团队，一起手搓出这款蜘蛛侠主题花车，有喜欢kigurumi的90后AI博导，不少社区里的同好如今成为他现实生活里的朋友、同事；科技风Coser“杜宾芝麻”，则在小红书上结识了流浪地球的道具师，身穿同好制作的服装在巡游里登场。
作为2.5次元社区一年一度的线下同好节日，RED LAND也是一次线上社区文化激发、引领年轻人线下真实生活的大型实践。白板表示，“做线下源于对真实生活和具体生活持续关注，马路生活节如此，外人节如此，RED LAND也是如此。我们希望年轻人从线上社区，走到线下的真实生活，找到更美好的生活方式。”

news.title: NBA 迈阿密热火队将在发售前一天穿着 GTA 6 球衣并在品牌球场上比赛
news.summary: The NBA's Miami Heat have announced that they will wear GTA 6 -inspired jerseys when they host the Milwaukee B

content.v: The NBA's Miami Heat have announced that they will wear GTA 6 -inspired jerseys when they host the Milwaukee Bucks on November 18, a day before the game releases. Additionally, the game will take place on a "never-before-seen court," and it'll be inspired by GTA 6 and Vice City.
The Heat play at the Kaseya Center in Miami, which was recently adorned with "Vice City" signage, airlifted in by helicopter . The game will air on ESPN on November 18. Tickets are on sale now .
There will also be "special activities" and "unique game night activations" on November 18 that the team will detail later. The new Heat jerseys and court design will also be revealed later.

As for what's available now, the Heat have rolled out a "Vice City Collection" of merch, including a $55 t-shirt that says, "Went to Vice City and all I got was this lousy t-shirt" and a $45 shirt that says, "I love Vice City." You can see the full collection at the Heat's online store .
The November 18 matchup is also notable because Heat star Giannis Antetokounmpo is playing against his former team, the Bucks, where he had spent his entire career until this season.
Rockstar is spending big money to advertise GTA 6 in Miami, and some local officials have expressed concerns .
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game has reportedly already sold close to 6 million copies, generating more than $570 million in pre-sales.
Also this week, Rockstar revealed that GTA 6 will have more than 170 animal species , including cane toads and monkeys. We also learned that GTA 6 has a new dynamic weather system .
